| | Dear Friend,

Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history, can make understanding the most important historical points difficult.

To uncover this fascinating history, we've produced our online course, "[Ancient Christianity](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zhnmhms3sf6f6dip2q6ocgusmo32vtb59aknh58g_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cpgm6p36c1h2bs)," now available on DVD.

In this course, Professor Kenneth Calvert is your guide through the first four centuries of Christianity as he explains the remarkable ways the new faith transformed the Roman world.

Would you help support this course so we can make it available to millions of Americans for free? As a token of our appreciation for your support, we'll send you a copy of our beautiful DVD Box Set for any donations of $100 or more.
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zc2j2tskgi2caq05n3d08sl59rh5b1prjce0nvn0_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cpgm6p36c1h2bs)

body:
I hear from people all the time that Thomas Sowell is one of their heroes.

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zoja2mja242mtmuvd7tqk3h7s5o0qtvovffgf4tg_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cpgm1o70c3h2bs)

| | Dear Friend,I hear from people all the time that Thomas Sowell is one of their heroes. For those people--and you may be among them--I'm thrilled to share a digital copy of one of his commentaries with you, absolutely free: _[**_"_****_Trickle Down " Theory and "Tax Cuts for the Rich._****_"_**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6t5grm5bvk5545543kqa0mrs2i5nms20ibgdo88_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cpgm1o70c3h2bs)_

---
| | "Tax cuts for the rich" is a favorite argument of those who oppose lower tax rates. But does imposing higher tax rates on wealthy Americans actually increase the amount of revenue coming into the federal government? Hoover Institution Senior Fellow **Thomas Sowell takes an empirical approach** in his commentary, [**_"_****_Trickle Down " Theory and "Tax Cuts for the Rich._****_"_**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zuvq0pv9qpc1pgnmagtlfgvpvt14lo3oa3iorf0g_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cpgm1o70c3h2bs) Sowell separates fact from fiction when it comes to tax rates and uses real life data and examples to prove that lower tax rates for all actually lead to greater revenue for the government. As a friend and supporter of the Hoover Institution, we are proud to offer you this valuable, thought-provoking resource free of charge.[**Click here to get your free copy of**** _ "Trickle Down" Theory and "Tax Cuts for the Rich" _****now.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zr7s31vnffisjd2ohpgjj725k4ptvqo2l69n57pg_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cpgm1o70c3h2bs) Thanks,Greg Greg Stamps | _Online Development_ Hoover Institution | Stanford University

body:
Elon Musk made a bold (and expensive) move to buy Twitter after seeing the tech giant de-platform The Babylon Bee simply for telling a joke.

Friend, Elon Musk made a bold (and expensive) move to buy Twitter after seeing the tech giant de-platform The Babylon Bee simply for telling a joke.While Elon joined The Bee in launching a revolution for free speech, X stood alone in rejecting unquestioning conformity. Censorship remained king on virtually every other social media platform, including Facebook. Despite the woke left's best efforts to silence The Babylon Bee, we haven't feared retribution from advertisers or being 'canceled' by woke social media platforms** because we have freedom-loving Americans like you who support our work.** **[**Subscribers are the backbone of The Babylon Bee, which allows us to battle for freedom of thought, the exchange of ideas, and truth. Your support as a member will allow us to continue creating satirical content and fighting for free speech.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zbjs0diarer3lkm011309r3fu5301aaeb76m2pfo_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cpim4ob6c1h2bs)**

---
Given Facebook's history of suppressing dissent, it was a huge surprise when Mark Zuckerberg, CEO of Facebook and Meta recently outed the Biden administration for demanding his platform censor opposing viewpoints.Appearing on Joe Rogan's podcast, Zuckerberg said:
---
_** "These people from the Biden administration would call up our team and, like, scream at them and curse**... Basically, it just got to this point where we were like, no, we're not going to take down things that are true... We just said, no, we're not going to take down humor and **satire**."_
---
**I wouldn 't be surprised if Biden's lackeys called up Twitter and demanded they silence The Babylon Bee** after we told a joke about Rachel Levine -- Biden's U.S. assistant secretary for health. It seems satirical that a website that got its start with church humor garnered national attention for telling a joke--but it's true, and it catapulted us into the national conversation on free speech. **[As a subscriber, you can help The Babylon Bee keep delivering fake news you can trust-- no matter what pressures we face from woke, anti-freedom activists.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z1n3qinm22jm9js9lt1r3iq31q2fm1b7tjnnr7ug_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cpim4ob6c1h2bs)**

---
Given what Mark Zuckerberg shared with Joe Rogan, it seems it was common practice for Biden's team to call up social media companies and demand they remove content the administration didn't like.We certainly didn't buy ourselves any favors with headlines including, "_Joe Biden found in dumpster behind DNC Convention Center " _and _" Joe Biden praised for historic rescue efforts to save kid he pushed down a well."_But, this is America, we value freedom, and we aren't going to apologize for writing satire. **Sorry, not sorry, Joe.** Even with Biden out the door, Trump in the White House, X leading Big Tech in its allegiance to free speech, and Facebook making strides to curb its suppression of thought ... _the censorship machine hasn 't dissolved_. **[**As the free speech war wages us, please help The Babylon Bee stand on the right side of history. Given Facebook's history of suppressing dissent, it was a huge surprise when Mark Zuckerberg, CEO of Facebook and Meta recently outed the Biden administration for demanding his platform censor opposing viewpoints.Appearing on Joe Rogan's podcast, Zuckerberg said: "These people from the Biden administration would call up our team and, like, scream at them and curse... Basically, it just got to this point where we were like, no, we're not going to take down things that are true... We just said, no, we're not going to take down humor and satire." I wouldn 't be surprised if Biden's lackeys called up Twitter and demanded they silence The Babylon Bee after we told a joke about Rachel Levine -- Biden's U.S. assistant secretary for health. It seems satirical that a website that got its start with church humor garnered national attention for telling a joke--but it's true, and it catapulted us into the national conversation on free speech. Given what Mark Zuckerberg shared with Joe Rogan, it seems it was common practice for Biden's team to call up social media companies and demand they remove content the administration didn't like.We certainly didn't buy ourselves any favors with headlines including, "Joe Biden found in dumpster behind DNC Convention Center " and " Joe Biden praised for historic rescue efforts to save kid he pushed down a well."But, this is America, we value freedom, and we aren't going to apologize for writing satire. Sorry, not sorry, Joe. Even with Biden out the door, Trump in the White House, X leading Big Tech in its allegiance to free speech, and Facebook making strides to curb its suppression of thought ... the censorship machine hasn 't dissolved. Thanks for supporting free speech. We 'll never give up the fight. Seth DillonCEO, The Babylon Bee | Copyright(C) 2023 Babylon Bee, All rights reserved. name: No Dem Left Behind Executive Director, Hassan Martini
subject: It Doesn't Have To Be This Way, Yet Here We Are.
body:
| | | | | | [](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wp65i-vg6zai-kyd76rh7/)
---
# **It Doesn't Have To Be This Way, Yet Here We Are.**
---
| | | | Hello friend, I meet and talk to people across the country, and I consider that one of the best perks of working in politics. You learn the most by stepping away from the computer or your phone, going to a place, and meeting people in person where they are. Human interaction is something I wish we had more of in our society—and definitely in our government. Right now, Americans—**all** Americans, regardless of their political affiliations—are upset. The American Dream has turned into an American fantasy for so many young people. Older Americans see this unfolding, and they, too, are upset because their children and grandchildren are not getting the same opportunities they once had in the greatest country in the world. America is a place where dreams can come true, and that should never be taken for granted. I was born in Syria, and in just one generation, I am leading a national organization responsible for helping elect our nation’s leaders. Not too many places besides America would make my story possible. I remember my parents struggling mightily to make ends meet, get their green cards, and eventually their citizenship. I still remember the date—December 4th. I’m not sure of the exact year, but it must have been sometime in the mid-nineties when they had their interview and received their green cards. I graduated from New York public schools and was in ESL (English as a Second Language) courses until my English improved. Then, I was placed in regular classes, and a few months later, in advanced classes and the gifted program. I was able to do all of this because of the opportunities this country provided my family. But for so many people today, that kind of life is no longer available. And the question is—**why not?** Let me share something with you from firsthand experience: When you come to this country with ambition and hunger and match that with opportunity, anything is possible. You know who is probably **not** coming into this country hungry and eager? Folks who have $5 million to pay for a **“gold card.”** Yes, they have money, but more often than not, they do not have the same ambition or drive as someone with no resources and no other choice but to succeed. Now, let’s fast forward 30 years. What happens to our country if we stay on this path? If we block all legal immigration except for the top 0.00001% of the global population, where will the innovation come from that has made America a world powerhouse? That is not a country or society worth being a part of. Not to mention, everyday Americans are being priced out of some of our most cherished experiences. Our major cities aren’t unaffordable because of hotels for immigrants—they’re unaffordable because the gap between the richest Americans and the middle class has never been bigger. Trump wants to make the best of America only available to the ultra-wealthy—from gutting our National Park Service to defunding our education system to flooding the country with tax-evading millionaires and billionaires. To fight back, we have to do better. **We need our elected members of Congress to do better.** Americans do not want to sell out our country to corporations and conglomerates. We do not want our kids to go to school hungry. We do not want to close down public schools or force our veterans to struggle even more than they already do. We do not want to conquer Canada, Greenland, or Panama, or displace two million Palestinians from their ancestral homeland. **This is not what we want.** And when I say “we,” I mean all Americans—even the MAGA faithful. We all want the same thing: to live a good life, provide for our families, and ensure our kids have an opportunity to do the same—or maybe even live a little better. **That is the message we need to run on—because it’s true.** Trump’s unilateral, idiotic trade wars are driving already high inflation even higher, while wages remain stagnant. And thanks to Elon Musk, hardworking Americans are losing their jobs. **Why?** Who voted to cut the VA? To fire our first responders? To cut cancer research? To end USAID? Who asked for this? The most tragic part? The only piece of legislation Republicans are actually trying to pass in Congress is a **$4 trillion tax cut** for corporations and the billionaire class. The greed is endless, as is the lack of compassion and empathy for the American people. [**_We are not backing down—we can’t afford to._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wp65i-vg6zaj-kyd76rh8/)[**_We must fight._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wp65i-vg6zak-kyd76rh9/) [**_We must deliver an alternative to the American people. And most importantly, we must_**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wp65i-vg6zal-kyd76rh0/)[** _win_**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wp65i-vg6zam-kyd76rh1/) [**_the upcoming elections—because children are counting on us._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wp65i-vg6zan-kyd76rh2/) In Solidarity, Hassan Martini

Human interaction is something I wish we had more of in our society—and definitely in our government. Right now, Americans—all Americans, regardless of their political affiliations—are upset. The American Dream has turned into an American fantasy for so many young people. Older Americans see this unfolding, and they, too, are upset because their children and grandchildren are not getting the same opportunities they once had in the greatest country in the world. America is a place where dreams can come true, and that should never be taken for granted. I was born in Syria, and in just one generation, I am leading a national organization responsible for helping elect our nation’s leaders. Not too many places besides America would make my story possible. I remember my parents struggling mightily to make ends meet, get their green cards, and eventually their citizenship. I still remember the date—December 4th. I’m not sure of the exact year, but it must have been sometime in the mid-nineties when they had their interview and received their green cards. I graduated from New York public schools and was in ESL (English as a Second Language) courses until my English improved. Then, I was placed in regular classes, and a few months later, in advanced classes and the gifted program. I was able to do all of this because of the opportunities this country provided my family. But for so many people today, that kind of life is no longer available. And the question is—why not? Let me share something with you from firsthand experience: When you come to this country with ambition and hunger and match that with opportunity, anything is possible. You know who is probably not coming into this country hungry and eager? Folks who have $5 million to pay for a “gold card.” Yes, they have money, but more often than not, they do not have the same ambition or drive as someone with no resources and no other choice but to succeed. Now, let’s fast forward 30 years. What happens to our country if we stay on this path? If we block all legal immigration except for the top 0.00001% of the global population, where will the innovation come from that has made America a world powerhouse? That is not a country or society worth being a part of. Not to mention, everyday Americans are being priced out of some of our most cherished experiences. Our major cities aren’t unaffordable because of hotels for immigrants—they’re unaffordable because the gap between the richest Americans and the middle class has never been bigger. Trump wants to make the best of America only available to the ultra-wealthy—from gutting our National Park Service to defunding our education system to flooding the country with tax-evading millionaires and billionaires. To fight back, we have to do better. We need our elected members of Congress to do better. Americans do not want to sell out our country to corporations and conglomerates. We do not want our kids to go to school hungry. We do not want to close down public schools or force our veterans to struggle even more than they already do. We do not want to conquer Canada, Greenland, or Panama, or displace two million Palestinians from their ancestral homeland. This is not what we want. And when I say “we,” I mean all Americans—even the MAGA faithful. We all want the same thing: to live a good life, provide for our families, and ensure our kids have an opportunity to do the same—or maybe even live a little better. That is the message we need to run on—because it’s true. Trump’s unilateral, idiotic trade wars are driving already high inflation even higher, while wages remain stagnant. And thanks to Elon Musk, hardworking Americans are losing their jobs. Why? Who voted to cut the VA? To fire our first responders? To cut cancer research? To end USAID? Who asked for this? The most tragic part? The only piece of legislation Republicans are actually trying to pass in Congress is a $4 trillion tax cut for corporations and the billionaire class. The greed is endless, as is the lack of compassion and empathy for the American people. In Solidarity, Hassan Martini | | | | | Thank you for your support in this pivotal time. | | | | | No Dem Left Behind PAC P.O. | | Dear Friend,

Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history, can make understanding the most important historical points difficult.

To uncover this fascinating history, we've produced our online course, "[Ancient Christianity](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/s/c/y9bri7CS4A3yCt83Nu2sBtCsmQmNHqIys-8Ym562GzUqYexMKOrGwmeJqOL_L71AZY2Bhhgtx_6Rs2Y4pl9ZjeER2CJIG3cytXgawVsxLx3W5xle4fwb1cV7ulzxtKt8L5MsBrHgFE5bOJcGbx197zbkdqynbpl_SKksRPFiVh-quzQuWXS25f5Yr2bjuV6yFPfQCssBYmRMUBShn069V3irEnZpMzPKeDxJgoGormwSXh3momu6zXLCIsHcPO4UxBLo5uNlezRCCX4GuiRHtN5H2NXNT8xnm9whfuorE21wwxUdKkf9SLyJh_optpd3NC37GDc7VmFEG8K2vHGnOQddm93-wcKL6LdFn1U12egfEhb2NSQREpQcPYpOFjaGHFdUYMX_U7Tg0IA3HkHfsQ1EFM_v2Ti-JckMPlI_R2N8O6JM7rbDbP8jcWXfCoBOzDI83ohjAwhUUk8u-P1gygu7N9MK6voOa5V4Asfn9l3L_2calVe8N-S76g/P1NapZeR4ONXu36V4zRCfCjzbhWnscPx/6)," now available on DVD.

## Trump Pauses Tariffs on Mexico, Canada
President Trump signed exemptions for tariffs on [imports from Canada and Mexico](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2u3CAQRp8GOlYwGLMuKNK427QprQkM64nAWDbZn7e_2tvf-vt0jnT-3JYbcuHt_hsrhZ7bAhqc0lZpvyTk8l4GmUImArKSgvGDsYPzepJrMAnIapvyAGkaJ0sumin-dTTmbG0GyeFD01Z7Y7R3_qIjekKLo4sZKZIYNCXu7bj8a7z1lXJ5twcdl9iqLGHtfT-F_SVgFjD3lVYu5bMJmNdWaaPnKWDGVHnjsx_YuW0CZmeuerJX1Y__dVcdD85Z0Yvq_jmoiBsmVJVeHJuAWR4h7U8uhc_Ri0HfK_K3RvafkjwCfAUAAP__sONk7A) that comply with the U.S.-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA), delaying duties until April 2. Trump reduced tariffs on Canadian potash from 25% to 10% and confirmed auto imports under USMCA would remain exempt. Despite the exemption, [tariffs still apply](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L1uxCAQBOCnwR0W5sdcCoo07i5tSouD5bwRBguwrXv7yImULs02O_o0ms_7fLcYMT0_7AqmhTxzxhVlgjI9e4vxNcvOmwDAQXRgBi0HIZVmb91iuApOcM_VzQcv2ShEGIZxvCkptLBadGgujQmmh4FppXvmrAYr7KhcsOCASAYeWy79V8bUFgjxlQ8ovctrF83S2laJeCd8Inw6z7N36eGuJ-HTRRM-MXGdkfCplX3daLMFQ6g04gF037xtUOljr5igVqj0tCXRHGjBbYtAfT4ThRDAtUpDyesf8ABn9wq_2YrpSV2urfZLW2NXjN9OjBHrqIlkz9Vi_Cnd_hvxMPw7AAD___44dhA) to about 50% of Mexican imports and more than 60% of Canadian goods.
## House Censures Speech Heckler
The House voted 224-198 Thursday to [censure Texas Democratic Rep.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGPhCAUhH8NdpgnqNwWFNfY7bVXmrfwEO5QDOCa_fcXr99mkskkX2bm-z7fMcSwLV-4kq4uzQLEwEFyULPFEF9z31jtiATJhnSn-k72g4Jb4zXATVrlSMDQ4wc8BMGICtw4KDOitU3QFw0kqK4DNagWDCpCieNgHJIh1gPZUFNuf1LYqicXX-lJuTVpbaL2te6FyU8mJiam8zxbsz3MFTIxXWgmJpCXjExMPh2FuKGtHJkKz7RzjHzJRBt3KXNP5veayms-1p3bI1-m7ETG85q4SduSqZTW1zU2Wdv9DDGGMirWw7JiiP-16rubnlr8BQAA___pAGsD) Al Green for heckling President Trump during his address to a joint session of Congress earlier this week. Ten [Democrats joined Republicans](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00DFvwyAUBOBfAxvR42ECHhi6eEvXjhbBz4EKmwhIovz7Kt67ne6kb7ify3zxKaf99u03cn0tMwJqAUqAmRef8nse-OJWIiTFyUkzSDVoAyOPztjVjspYNVprrxoh-IBa2tEoeV0U8uQ-GigwUoLR5gTBG_LKn3VYPQViA9CSeqmn35L2HmnN7_Kkegpl49nF3u-NqS-GE8OpR4op58_GcIplo51e7YiPRgwnLS0oHIQEcVRioa2E6nsTgfb2qCR8FrdKtDOceHXL_ZVyTu1s2AC3zacD5_2_I54O_wIAAP__RrNe8A) in censuring Green, rebuking the 11-term congressman for waving his cane and yelling at Trump, prompting his removal from the chamber. After the vote, Green was ordered to stand in the chamber while the resolution, condemning his behavior as "a breach of proper conduct," was read aloud. A group of Democrats joined Green on the chamber floor, and together they began singing the civil rights anthem _We Shall Overcome_. [See them singing here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z7Fu7CAQheGngW6tYQDPvQVFGnebNqXFwnhNhM3GRkbO00dOn-5IR_qk_-M-3n3KaX2--4VdncqIgPYG-gY0Rp_yORoZ3cSMrCU7RUZpYwn-y9kRacAQAzIaZhX19K9n641VUQWCXiZ3aaCBlAKy1EHwxF773obJc2BhgGOqZes-S1rrzFM-y8FbF8ois5trfe1CvwkcBA6tte7xCNcncFi57QKHI0Uu1wj2BP1l27d5Frm5-Gop57T3JAw8F5_yr1n_ajwc_gQAAP__5K9TNQ).
## Study: U.S. Leads in Millionaires
The U.S. has more high-net-worth individuals than any other country, [with nearly 40%](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1uhDAQBp8GOqP1DzhXuEhDd2lTosVejj3ZGIE5dG8fkdRptpnRaPV934c7cuTl8YWJXJnyoEC1ArQAOwTk-B5MHdxEpEjX5KQ1UpvWwq2enW7bzgQctdLWdlZLQHOTYVQK1EeQvmZ31UCDlRJsaxvwaAk1dq2fkDxVBihwyVvzzLyUmab4zi_aGp9THd1cyrpX-rNSfaX68zwbv4z-gpXqr3SletDX6S5OGMss_EZYOC-CdzHmnHh5CNzFsYt0xMKJY-S8IG8k1rwe8U9-Hmndm7mkWG8urOdl7Z2tDDwScvx9qPw30MupnwAAAP__yY9ojw) of the world’s super-rich residing in America, according to a 2025 wealth report. The report found that the U.S. outpaced other countries in creating and attracting high-net-worth individuals—people with more than $10 million in assets—fueled by strong financial markets and the 2024 bitcoin surge. The U.S. is home to over 900,000 [ultra-high-net-worth individuals](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFugzAQQL8GNkdnY3Nk8NAlW7p2RAc-h6scnMI1Ufr1Vbp3fcN70vs4j2eSIuvlna4cNdfRgQsGOgM4JpLyHH2bYmZ23LUcLXrb-YBwbJfYT9MxYcJpyJO3OXNmOE4T05ADBD-0El826ACtBQx4gJmQqaM-zJl45sYDJ9G6HT6rrLpwLs965-0w12tb4qJ625vurXGnxp2-fl64cSdZjQPnzfcqysnsSsq7KZyMLmwedSvJyGoeTEUXM29MKnU1dggWe8Rg2y2m20NKkb3HxsPlSlL-mvrfg3t0vwEAAP___JZetg), more than double the number in second-place China. While global high-net-worth individuals grew by 4.4%, the U.S. saw a 5.2% increase.

## Tesla Megafactory Coming to Texas
Tesla is planning to open a [new 600,000-square-foot manufacturing facility](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2ShCAQhJ8GM6wBUTQguMRsL73QGmFYqUPZ0tm_t79y80u6Ovq66_u5TBdMOW3Xb1zJ8SuWSYNuJTQS7BQw5fdkquBmCIOqyClrVGP6oe-qxaFvUUWj58F3ptMxkkaLuh96S2qGtkruhEEDVql2gLa2XtnW4hzmrgOgKAxQSFz2mhdieuER87s8aK99WavsFubbIZovoUehR8rkeaff2hehxxMt9AjNGWdjOjJKLnK-pxwkyo2ecqUrRvRc9rdMm_xsyI1wl0u5H1w2ocdqd-H2TDmno7PCwHXFlD8P-F8lD6f_AgAA__9_XGKw) in Brookshire to build its large-scale Megapack batteries. The company already operates Megafactories in China, California, and Nevada. Waller County approved an incentive agreement with the company for a combined $227 million in facility improvements, manufacturing equipment, and distribution equipment. Records indicate the plant [could employ 1,500 workers](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOqzAQRb8GOqOxMRgKF69Jl9duiQZ7DJYMjmASh79fZbfe6jZX50jn6z7dMaa4L_9xI8vvkCcFqhPQCjCTx5iuSdfezuBHWZOVRstWD-PQ16sNYNDD3OEQRqP7YVSjcYG0n2cl1YB1tB8YtGCk7EboGuOk6QzOfu57AAqVBvKR89HwSkxvPEO68ouOxuWtTnZlfpxV-69St0rdSilNyG_Vr_l5ct4_p0rddirn7wimM6HYaMGAjvNxiYAupsiXcHmL-yIKpkSHcPm581Uf1j9KTCmevak0LBvG9KPmP1u8rPoOAAD__1PrY_Q) within three years. A company representative said the facility will be able to produce [10,000 Megapacks a year](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OqzAQRp_GdKDxfyhc3IYut90SGXscrDUxMpOQvP0q22_3SZ90jnS-rvPV55Lvt_9-Q0evVGcBQvcge7Bz9Lm8Z9VFt0AceYeOW8WluowX061OQTJcBp6EElpGoxEXroNEnowSfumy-8BAguVcj6AHG7jV1i9xMQYAE1OAMVNtA61I-PJHKu_6xDaEunXFrUT7weQ_JiYmpvM8h7C2ev-8TEzhUejRkInJN8qhfBbhUXy_4c3vPnz3yQeq7d2v9XFQvfcCBBgY9bCve9dc3M9cSj6MZQpum8_lV0x_lng68RMAAP__tL9g4g), each with the capacity to power 3,600 homes for an hour. Tesla recently opened a lithium refinery in Corpus Christi and plans to add five million square feet to its Austin manufacturing campus by the end of the year.
## Plano Police Uncover Murder-For-Hire Plot
A Plano police detective [uncovered a murder-for-hire plot](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L1uhDAQBOCngc5oARtD4SIN3aVNiYy9PlbyDzI-uHv7iPTppvg0Gs3PY3lo8hSf3zqgKm-Xlg46waBnIBeryX8WXlu1gp3aGlUredvzcRqHelNG6rUdOZhhgFHzSawo-gFWt6ITwpma1F0GPci2FROIRppWCqlXuw4DALqKA1oqKTdlw4JvfTj_SSfmxqRQe7WVsh9V_1V1c9XN13U1Lr15xOu4QdXNd6y6OZDZNHoWjPHpZVl4ZYuZuZTZRhmZSfEkUyhFtnsdE9uTJ4PM4q5zCRgLo3jiUeipb1VnZfeLvKdjkBWHZ9Dk_zaVf086VfcbAAD__ww3beo) during an investigation into package thefts and vehicle burglaries, potentially saving the lives of two people. While off duty, C. McEntire, a 24-year veteran of the Plano Police Department, ran into the 38-year-old burglary suspect Michael McCloud at a restaurant McCloud was known to frequent. Unaware that McEntire was a police officer, McCloud “started talking about his ex-girlfriend and that he needed a silencer to take care of her and her new boyfriend.” McEntire told McCloud he could help and [put him in touch with an undercover ATF agent](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLuupDAQRL_GZEZN8zAEDjYhu5tuiPxowFIbI-MZZv5-NZPf9JSqVDr_fpYfEzgc218TSZfXmhYE7CW0EtTiTeD30lVeW_BTU5FuVNe03TiNQ7VrnCYAWEckNP0AdiDo7ei8dX4iRKiC_oxBC6pp-gn6WrlG9cpYb4cBgFbRAflQUq7LToVe5lr5nZ6Ua5dixXov5bxE-0fgLHC-77t29jrovj65wPlbETh_kMD5ZHMk-YUymkPG4HZDLKNznB5enkzGX3J7BC5vGR_ZU5ZrynIPmSS95BYyrznQ4QXOVdb-vANzuAYlOtiiCfw9Vn419dT4PwAA__9pIG35). McCloud was arrested after sharing he was looking for someone to kill the two. He recently pleaded guilty to the federal charge of murder for hire, and he faces 15 years to life in prison. In January, McEntire was honored with a service award for his work on the case. "_Detective McEntire’s investigative insight, determination, and effective communication played a crucial role in preventing a capital murder_ ," said a [statement from the department](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL3O3CAQRZ8Gd1jDGIxdUKRxt2lTWpgZ1kj4R5isd98-2vRfeXWlo6Pz5zE_fMppf_72G7v6jseMgEZCJ8HO5FP-zLohtwCNqmGnrFadHsahb1YXCH0A0pZGUkYHop6MGW1cBh-Mt01yXxh0YJUyI5jWBmWN9QstfQ_AUWhgSvUobV258ttfMX-OF5c2HFuT3VrreYnul8BJ4HTfd3tH77-nwMmXmkJmgdPO9yVwCiVt33lmvx-yrhyrLGl_yu1vIS4yHkWuqbA881EFTjhYOWIflzgEyahHqY0FOXRgpIq0aET2rKApjs475Zyu3goNz82n_N-w_pjs5fBfAAAA__9o4Gxm).
## SXSW Kicks Off
The annual South By Southwest (SXSW) festival kicks off in Austin today. It will feature film showings, musical performances, discussions on culture and current events, and a slew of new tech products. Officials expect close to [half a million people](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OqzAUhJ_GdEbHP9ihcHEbutx2S2TiQ2LJYMTxYnj7VbL11jOa-fR93ce7jymuz_9-QVfOOY8SZMdBcbBj8DFdo26CmyD0okEnrBZK3_qbaV5OgTTC6IA2dAHCI_RCg0Rj1aRunZ6b6N5joMAK0fXQtfYhbGf9FCZjAHBmGjDEkve2vLDg6WlOVz5wbx95aZJ7lbIRU_-YHJgcaq3tnE_rv6nE9V1hclixEpMDnVT5B_035ZH4tuPmdwx8Rirx8IkTesorX_yVd07-omZ3YasxpUjGMg3Pxcf0OS9_2jic_AkAAP__QFljQw) to visit the downtown area by the end of the festival next Saturday. body:
Control of Congress is at stake

| | | | [](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a6sw/?__vbtrk=Mjc4NTE0OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc4NTE0OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
---
Friend, President Trump's trifecta is at risk.
Two critical House seats, **FL-01** and **FL-06** , are facing special elections right now and the Radical Left is throwing everything they’ve got into these races to defeat us and take the House.
This is about much more than just two House seats. This is the first electoral test for the GOP since Trump’s historic victory last November.
This is about maintaining the House GOP Majority as a whole which has been the vanguard for President Trump and his administration.
This is where we must draw the line in the sand. Our GOP House majority provides President Trump with the support he needs to fulfill his agenda and save our country.
Losing these races means that we will hand over the House to the DNC’s minions on a silver platter and any further attempt to fulfill **Agenda 47 will be dead on arrival****.**
The consequences of failing to hold the line are hard to overstate.

The first thing the Democrats will do if they take the House is move to impeach President Trump. If that happens we would be back to 2019 when we were fighting an uphill battle at every turn to overcome Leftist obstruction.
_**Securing our borders**_ , _**unleashing energy dominance**_ , _**reducing inflation**_ , and **_crushing Deep State corruption_** are all on the line.
We have fought too hard to deliver an America First agenda to just let our hard won victory slip away now.

_**[The House GOP Battleground Fund was created to ensure our team of experienced GOP operatives have the resources they need to stay in the fight and defend the House seats that will determine the balance of power in our country](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a6sw/?__vbtrk=Mjc4NTE0OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc4NTE0OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct).**_
[DEFEND THE HOUSE](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a6sw/?__vbtrk=Mjc4NTE0OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc4NTE0OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
We have won fights like these before but time is quickly running out to give our team in the field the support they need to make a difference. Both special elections will take place on **April 1st** and that date is rapidly approaching.
Right now, DNC operatives are arriving in the Sunshine State from all over the country...
And according to their leaked donor calls they are securing enough special interest cash to flip both seats **BLUE**.
Friend, If we do not take immediate action then we run the risk of being outspent in the final stretch of these races.
**__[We are calling in the cavalry and we need America First patriots from across the nation to help us secure FL-01 and FL-06](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a6sw/?__vbtrk=Mjc4NTE0OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc4NTE0OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_._**
[SECURE VICTORY IN FLORIDA](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a6sw/?__vbtrk=Mjc4NTE0OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc4NTE0OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Securing these seats means protecting the Trump trifecta.
Last year voters gave President Trump and the GOP control of the _**White House**_ , control of the _**Senate**_ , AND control of the _**House**_.
But if Democrats take back the House they will pass legislation to change our election laws, like allowing illegal immigrants to vote, that will rig future elections in their favor and make it harder for Republicans to secure a trifecta again.
**Democrats are already attempting to pass laws in New York City that would allow non-citizens to vote!**
If they succeed it may take a generation before we see the type of resounding mandate that the American People gave to Save America and usher in a new age of American greatness.
**Our actions now will determine if our children and future generations will inherit chaos or a free and prosperous nation.**
We are the firewall _**against open borders**_ , _**against socialist policies**_ that lead to sky high inflation, _**against radical gender ideology**_ that allows men in girls' private spaces, and _**against the Swamp**_ abusing power.
_**_[To maintain that firewall we need to make a stand and ensure that we send conservative warriors to Congress to represent FL-01 and FL-06. So please consider contributing whatever you can today to fuel our defense of the House](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a6sw/?__vbtrk=Mjc4NTE0OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc4NTE0OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_.**_
[FUEL THE HOUSE GOP BATTLEGROUND FUND](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a6sw/?__vbtrk=Mjc4NTE0OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc4NTE0OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Thank you for you time and your continued support of our team and the America First movement. It is because of you that we are able to continue fighting to save America.

name: History Facts
subject: When did rural Americans start getting mail?
body:
While residents of the biggest cities in the U.S. enjoyed the luxury of free mail delivery to their homes beginning in 1863, it was more than three decades before rural dwellers could depend on regular mail access that didn't involve an inconvenient trek to the nearest town.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=1krv9cfc68dgsebedxabyvnpoywhrledbj19fvt0q20syxo407lser5r24cv1nx753km04f1pohgzimzbzs3pkpwo9fypi2i6vg59thzf0li0a512rma41oc3md59e4pffwr7fdc6j9d885quah3zrjbn&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssr5k4&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
---

# [Rural Americans didn't get mail at home until the late 19th century.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssr5k4&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Science & Industry](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssr5k4&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssr5k4&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| W hile residents of the biggest cities in the U.S. enjoyed the luxury of free [mail delivery](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssr5k4&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) to their homes beginning in 1863, it was more than three decades before rural dwellers could depend on regular mail access that didn't involve an inconvenient trek to the nearest town. Initial pushes to expand delivery service came from department store magnate John Wanamaker, who served as postmaster general in the early 1890s, and Georgia politician Tom Watson, who initiated a bill to fund the expansion in 1893. Finally, new postmaster general William L. Wilson agreed to launch an experimental rural free delivery (RFD) service in three West Virginia towns in 1896.
---
There were a few challenges that stood in the way of rural mail delivery, including the crude roads that made traveling between towns a harrowing experience in winter. What’s more, rural carriers, who were [paid less](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssr5k4&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) than their urban counterparts, were expected to provide their own transportation. But as it turned out, Americans outside of busy urban centers were strongly yearning not only for mail delivery, but also for the connection to the world at large that carriers relayed via newspapers and basic social interaction. Thousands of residents of previously isolated areas rounded up the signatures needed to petition for RFD service, and rebuilt their local roads and bridges to ensure safer passageways. Following steady expansion of delivery routes into the next century, Americans of all but the most impossible-to-reach locales could rejoice when RFD was designated a permanent service effective July 1, 1902.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssr5k4&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) | [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssr5k4&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

## The ubiquitous tunnel mailbox was created in 1915.
Although many residents of remote regions diligently worked to upgrade their roads for mail service at the turn of the 20th century, less attention was paid to the soap boxes and sticky old food containers they supplied as mailboxes. The U.S. Post Office Department subsequently sought to establish a standardized model for these receptacles by 1901, specifying dimensions of at least 18 inches by 6 inches and naming 14 manufacturers from which customers could purchase sheet metal boxes. Still, many rural residents continued to provide their own homemade mailboxes, many of which proved unable to store the larger packages that circulated with the commencement of Parcel Post service in 1913. The proper means for streamlining finally arrived in 1915, when postal engineer Roy Joroleman designed the now-familiar [tunnel mailbox](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssr5k4&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) with its nifty flag on the side, raised to signal when the box was full with incoming or outgoing mail. With only these mailboxes permitted to be installed by July 1, 1916, Joroleman's design soon became the standard across the U.S. countryside and a widely recognized symbol of 20th-century Americana.

clean_body: While residents of the biggest cities in the U.S. enjoyed the luxury of free mail delivery to their homes beginning in 1863, it was more than three decades before rural dwellers could depend on regular mail access that didn't involve an inconvenient trek to the nearest town. | W hile residents of the biggest cities in the U.S. enjoyed the luxury of free to their homes beginning in 1863, it was more than three decades before rural dwellers could depend on regular mail access that didn't involve an inconvenient trek to the nearest town. Initial pushes to expand delivery service came from department store magnate John Wanamaker, who served as postmaster general in the early 1890s, and Georgia politician Tom Watson, who initiated a bill to fund the expansion in 1893. Finally, new postmaster general William L. Wilson agreed to launch an experimental rural free delivery (RFD) service in three West Virginia towns in 1896. There were a few challenges that stood in the way of rural mail delivery, including the crude roads that made traveling between towns a harrowing experience in winter. What’s more, rural carriers, who were than their urban counterparts, were expected to provide their own transportation. But as it turned out, Americans outside of busy urban centers were strongly yearning not only for mail delivery, but also for the connection to the world at large that carriers relayed via newspapers and basic social interaction. Thousands of residents of previously isolated areas rounded up the signatures needed to petition for RFD service, and rebuilt their local roads and bridges to ensure safer passageways. Following steady expansion of delivery routes into the next century, Americans of all but the most impossible-to-reach locales could rejoice when RFD was designated a permanent service effective July 1, 1902. | By clicking a link in this email, you're agreeing to our and . By the Numbers | | Congressional funds used to start RFD service in 1896 $40,000 | | Percentage of the U.S. population that lived in rural areas in 1900 60% | Percentage of the U.S. population that lived in rural areas in 1900 60% | | Post offices across the U.S. in 1901, the most in American history 76,945 | | Pieces of mail processed daily by the USPS in 2023 318 million | Pieces of mail processed daily by the USPS in 2023 318 million | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- The ubiquitous tunnel mailbox was created in 1915. Although many residents of remote regions diligently worked to upgrade their roads for mail service at the turn of the 20th century, less attention was paid to the soap boxes and sticky old food containers they supplied as mailboxes. The U.S. Post Office Department subsequently sought to establish a standardized model for these receptacles by 1901, specifying dimensions of at least 18 inches by 6 inches and naming 14 manufacturers from which customers could purchase sheet metal boxes. Still, many rural residents continued to provide their own homemade mailboxes, many of which proved unable to store the larger packages that circulated with the commencement of Parcel Post service in 1913. The proper means for streamlining finally arrived in 1915, when postal engineer Roy Joroleman designed the now-familiar with its nifty flag on the side, raised to signal when the box was full with incoming or outgoing mail. With only these mailboxes permitted to be installed by July 1, 1916, Joroleman's design soon became the standard across the U.S. countryside and a widely recognized symbol of 20th-century Americana. name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 3/7/2025
body:
The fantasy Mayor Mike Johnston paints for Congress on crime is not the everyday reality, residents say
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
Here is a summary of today's top stories: ****
**🏛️ Colorado Legislative Session Updates...** At a town hall, Rep. Jeff Crank declared [SB 3 “just unconstitutional,”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) warning that the gun control measure targeting semiautomatic firearms violates Second Amendment rights and will face legal challenges.
**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** Mayor Mike Johnston told Congress Denver’s [crime rates are improving](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), but Rep. Gabe Evans and residents [pushed back](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), citing persistent issues with theft, drugs, and homelessness. Colorado Parks and Wildlife is compensating ranchers for livestock losses to wolves, raising concerns about [long-term sustainability](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). La Plata Electric Association members oppose a [$210 million plan](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to leave Tri-State Generation, fearing higher electricity costs and financial instability.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** President Trump plans an executive order to dismantle the Education Department, shifting [control to states](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). California’s governor [broke with Democrats](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) by opposing biological males in women’s sports. Trump will hold biweekly meetings with Elon Musk to streamline [federal workforce cuts](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** An op-ed warns that Colorado’s special districts rely on [voter ignorance](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to operate with minimal oversight, calling for more transparency in public spending. Another column argues that the Department of Education has [failed its purpose](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), advocating for its abolition.

This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, March 7, 2025.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[The fantasy Mayor Mike Johnston paints for Congress on crime is not the everyday reality, residents say](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Jeff Workman never imagined that stepping onto his porch would leave him battered, unable to work and afraid to open his door after dark. His brutal attack wasn’t an isolated incident.
“At 10:30 p.m. on Aug. 20, my girlfriend and I were brutally assaulted while sitting on my front porch,” Workman said. “Without saying anything, the man immediately ripped me off my porch and I fell down its four steps, landing hard on the sidewalk. I was severely injured, dazed and helpless.”
The attack left Workman with a separated shoulder, multiple torn ligaments and a serious spinal injury that required emergency surgery. He is now unable to walk without a walker, unable to work and unable to care for his 98-year-old grandmother.
“This attack destroyed life as I know it,” he said.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Here’s the facts Rep. Gabe Evans used in hearing that Mayor Mike Johnston disputes](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* During a congressional hearing, Rep. Gabe Evans challenged Denver Mayor Mike Johnston’s claims of improving crime rates, presenting data that ranked Denver as one of the most dangerous cities in the U.S., with a crime occurring every 56 seconds.
* Evans cited reports showing Denver has moved into the top 10 most dangerous cities, while Colorado ranks third in the nation for crime and second for property crime. Johnston dismissed these statistics as outdated or misleading.
* Evans cited rising auto theft, overdoses, and gang activity, blaming policy failures and strained services from illegal immigration and homelessness.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[‘Everyone feels anxiety’ over CPW depredation payments, but commissioners note it’s the law](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado Parks and Wildlife (CPW) approved over $343,000 in compensation to ranchers in Grand County for livestock losses caused by reintroduced wolves, with additional claims under review.
* Colorado is the only western state that compensates ranchers beyond the value of the killed livestock, also covering reduced pregnancy rates and lower weaning weights due to wolf stress.
* While ranchers appreciate the payments, officials acknowledge widespread anxiety over the long-term viability of the program and its financial burden on the state.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[In $210M plan to ditch Tri-State, LPEA members feel the financial pinch](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* LPEA members are facing a potential rate hike of 7.7%, which could add up to $90 annually for most customers. Some residents, like rancher J. Paul Brown, could see their monthly electric bills increase by over $300.
* LPEA’s plan to cut ties with Tri-State comes with a $210 million price tag, sparking debate over financial stability and future energy costs. While LPEA aims to transition to solar and alternative energy sources, members worry about affordability and reliability.
* Residents are voicing concerns over transparency and the long-term impact of the transition. Many fear that the shift to new energy sources will come with unforeseen costs and potential service disruptions.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
** ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[O’Reilly: Special districts bank on your ignorance, residents need to push for transparency](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY CHUCK O'REILLY | COMMENTARY | MARCH 6** _Meet Colorado’s special districts. Your wallet knows them better than you. Your tax dollars feed special districts most can’t even name. They siphon cash quietly until they are exposed._ ____
**[Garbo: In public education’s betrayal of America, Department of Education abolishment is long overdue](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY C. J. GARBO****| COMMENTARY | MARCH 6** _Public education was the single most destructive force of my life. It was not just a failed system; it was a weapon – an insidious mechanism that fostered and cultivated powerful lies about my self-image and self-worth that took decades to unlearn._ ______
**[Rep. Jeff Crank ‘totally opposed’ to ‘just unconstitutional’ SB 3, he says in town hall](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY BRIAN PORTER****| STATE | MARCH 6** _As he debates the policy of the day in Washington, D.C., U.S. Rep. Jeff Crank, R-Colo. Springs, has an eye on Colorado’s General Assembly. He’s concerned with the passage of Colorado Senate Bill 25-003 out of the Senate and to the House._ __

| | Dear Friend,

Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history, can make understanding the most important historical points difficult.

To uncover this fascinating history, we've produced our online course, "[Ancient Christianity](https://links.conservativesgive.com/s/c/7uKAndMHhoJ002Mxr6PW5td-sxdeJlFrQtwQyX5jY1B0xmxnaPdY0G7-RR_eH7sf9jOvkZEmOlja-jIyOriN6Y1wCB8P372DhIbVL7M5sT22t4a9tWy-CEsGu70HTSN6xoPunKO8R2KrIoaVz-wQxwxduHhpeUeD9J-6uLQ_pVJY9XRvvB2DQKm5vwfUbSaB90x5JtQAbs5kVh4YO7KTCQVxYiloKs9amsfpydfvRMspLwrAbHPYOyopo3Kuh8Wg7hiwYmGobP-z80E2V8ZoU4vZao2JGcBTijdX4A7mGLy3NIZh4XCrJ8eQeLMCot5V6e_Repl5ri0K1HzagClxUhrrcEv0QcO75BUv-J7vfFDf_flwnyMwYbiC0EkLyjxcegLvRoWhWFxYUJ9lcfc_CCrPjhbftq5fXKB2LFhXOLlpRnSb7CwYPaMWoPImW3zfiTz8iwicGsU7lTMBB0XrXvXybA-cywfrHuTBWM2uESxJ1Q7xhspDDpVDfw/m-HO77lzTda2g0oiVGe7kC5h0TR2Vfwz/6)," now available on DVD.

These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture. But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history, can make understanding the most important historical points difficult. | Hi Friend,

Trump’s unlawful spending freeze is still hurting Americans, despite three judges ordering it to stop. His actions are causing real and direct harm to families who rely on federally-funded programs to put food on the table, access healthcare, keep the heat on in the winter, and so much more.

But that was just part one of the saga.

Now, through a process called “budget reconciliation,” **Republicans are trying to cut funding off permanently** , going after life-saving programs like Medicaid and gutting popular Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) programs that lower energy costs, make transportation safer and healthier, and create good-paying jobs.

It can be a lot to wrap your head around and make sense of it all, but our blog is here to help! To learn more about the funding freeze, what it means for everyday Americans, and how Congress can take action, **check out the following explainers we published recently:** |

It can be a lot to wrap your head around and make sense of it all, but our blog is here to help! subject: Why chemistry?
body:
A tough question

_**A message from our sponsor...**_

| | | [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=ebd4064e28514521ad669bc6290d7125&_e=V6RCyc6oAePoBbBrdfSS015dxbtSFnj66DPlSypLsMghZnzYcO_xwfjuou2VnZoJ5vIWM6ArZehL1fpanCpEijz23-iolswazM0WijobFpGZZWdZyQTaapHAr95KzqWfMov4S_g7hvQQSlzTFArtsgw6hkY7rFwi88pIx9tE7EHhi6B04K_DfRS4XWUgQVklA0jj1Wq-nYFYCubpPbiWPDFosTLKrU4NTHHDE1G0lq_Vxtw-JheIvuf_wlWTBpca1LySt-Ko9CFsD0c3QeEelTT3I4YlNXNI3LBoWRghpF1ib2CnodG4hAPUaYNaZ8BF-Y4yrKJW93UnjmOYmdhVvh60T60Sr_3UhtmHrHezOXx4dJEhJKvwyYO9CmAO1wOdWhor6e0byIgRKfF7mUr2-A%3D%3D)
---
| | Dear Friend,

There's a tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day.

Here it is...What is true about the world?

Tough, right?

It's a question mankind has asked since ancient times--since creation itself. So, if you don't know the answer, that's fine (if you do, email me because I would love to know more!).

This question is especially pressing today because of the growing power modern humans have to change and manipulate the material world.

That's one of the reasons we released our free online course, **" The Great Principles of Chemistry."**

Why chemistry?

For one, this course brings a core subject studied at Hillsdale College to millions of Americans, including you.

More fundamentally, we study chemistry as part of our liberal arts education at Hillsdale because the sciences help us understand important aspects of reality. It helps us think about our role as humans in the world around us and reveals the framework, implications, and potential for human life.

Like all our courses, **" The Great Principles of Chemistry"** contains stunning visuals, study guides, quizzes, and in this case, hands-on experiments. This content is especially well-suited for science teachers, homeschool parents, or lifelong learners.

And our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

**For any donation of $100 or more, you will receive a beautiful DVD box set for "The Great Principles of Chemistry," by clicking the link below:

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/principles-of-chemistry](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=ebd4064e28514521ad669bc6290d7125&_e=V6RCyc6oAePoBbBrdfSS015dxbtSFnj66DPlSypLsMghZnzYcO_xwfjuou2VnZoJ5vIWM6ArZehL1fpanCpEijz23-iolswazM0WijobFpGZZWdZyQTaapHAr95KzqWfMov4S_g7hvQQSlzTFArtsgw6hkY7rFwi88pIx9tE7EHhi6B04K_DfRS4XWUgQVklA0jj1Wq-nYFYCubpPbiWPDFosTLKrU4NTHHDE1G0lq_Vxtw-JheIvuf_wlWTBpcakHjx3bPNACpLxG3GBpB7FJRLDER3UUnpHpOeVTeO4qNWEPEFtD3pKqY3P_96W8czRQJK8MyUZtmIqS4Yj_5hkU9gTCNGoW0AvRl8xhQpojCQUEuGxhq96V5HvHNmbtW2Vt2lEF91qTP7ixIMoKYdHQ%3D%3D)

The proper study of chemistry helps us understand the world and inspires wonder and awe at the beauty of creation and its Creator.

For these reasons, please join us in helping others gain a greater appreciation for the world around us with **" The Great Principles of Chemistry."**

Let's promote what's true about our world together.

Warm Regards,

Bill Gray, ‘01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

White House press Secretary Karoline Leavitt **[scolded a reporter](https://substack.com/redirect/75046f79-476c-4e92-a02e-4b3cbf1b2c34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for challenging President Trump's tariff negotiations and downplaying the fentanyl coming across the northern border from Canada.
_**["YOU are not the president!" ](https://substack.com/redirect/75046f79-476c-4e92-a02e-4b3cbf1b2c34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/75046f79-476c-4e92-a02e-4b3cbf1b2c34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/75046f79-476c-4e92-a02e-4b3cbf1b2c34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"As you know, less than 1% of fentanyl seized last year was at the northern border. What. ore does Canada need to do?" the reporter pressed Leavitt.
**[The press secretary, as usual, was very prepared:](https://substack.com/redirect/75046f79-476c-4e92-a02e-4b3cbf1b2c34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** "For the last 4 years, unfortunately, our neighbors to the north and the south, Canada and Mexico, have allowed America to be a dumping ground," Leavitt said sternly. "Not just for illegal aliens, but for illegal poisonous, deadly fentanyl!"
"It's the number one killer of young people in this country, aged 18-34!" she continued. "At the northern border in Canada, in the last fiscal year alone, there was enough fentanyl to seized to kill 4.8 billion people! There has been more than a 2000% increase in illegal fentanyl seizure at the northern border. Why? Because Canada is allowing that fentanyl to come to the United States!" Leavitt explained.
The answer wasn't enough for the reporter, so he followed up, asking the same question again, "The vast majority of the fentanyl is brought in from Mexico, not Canada, so what more does Canada need to do?!" he fired back at Leavitt.
**["I just told you! "Leavitt responded, frustrated.](https://substack.com/redirect/75046f79-476c-4e92-a02e-4b3cbf1b2c34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** "It's not up to you! You're not the President! And frankly I think it's a little bit disrespectful to the families in this country who have lost loved ones to this deadly poison."

# **Jim Jordan TEARS nervous Democrat mayor a new one for betraying his own people**
GOP Rep. Jim Jordan **[went off on sanctuary city mayor Mike Johnston of Denver](https://substack.com/redirect/b8987a91-f4ac-4d13-849b-9a85c88232f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for releasing an illegal immigrant gang member back into America and not giving I.C.E enough notice to apprehend him.
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/b8987a91-f4ac-4d13-849b-9a85c88232f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

The mayor defended himself, trying to explain the process of release, "What we do sir, is we release him from our county jail and we coordinate with I.C.E. on that release time so that I.C.E. can pick them up from that location."
"Guess what happened in the parking lot!" Jordan snapped. "One of the I.C.E. officers got assaulted, didn't he?!!"
"I know sir, I reviewed the video,... We've been doing these 1226 times, this is the first time I've been made aware of where there has been an incident like this!" the Johnston said.
**[Jordan had no patience for the mayor's excuses,](https://substack.com/redirect/b8987a91-f4ac-4d13-849b-9a85c88232f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** watch the explosive questioning right here:

Peter, if we haven’t met, my name is Madison Horn.

In 2024, I ran to represent Oklahoma’s 5th Congressional District. I think it’s important to share a bit about that experience with you today:

When I first connected with Her Bold Move, I had already reached out to nearly every major women’s organization in the country. I was running for office in Oklahoma — a state ranked as the worst place in the US for women, with the strictest abortion laws and a staggering **_50% of women experiencing rape or domestic violence in their lifetime._** Despite this dire reality, my candidacy received little to no support.

It was disheartening. These were organizations with bold mission statements about empowering women. Yet, when presented with a woman bravely running for office in a red state, the response was silence. Time and again, I was left wondering: If the most well-funded organizations won’t stand by their missions, what is their purpose? To just keep re-electing the same women who already won their races in blue states?

That’s why, **when I received the news that Her Bold Move was endorsing me, I was nearly brought to tears. It wasn’t just about the endorsement. It was about an organization that believed women in Oklahoma were worth fighting for.** It was about an organization willing to live its mission and declare, loudly and clearly: _We understand how hard it is to run for office as a woman in your state. We are standing in this fight with you._

What happened next left me even more in awe. **The day after my endorsement, four different resources from Her Bold Move reached out to offer media support, social media strategy, volunteer assistance, and seasoned advisors.** I couldn’t believe it. For the first time, I felt like I wasn’t on an island shouting into the void about the harsh realities in Oklahoma. **Her Bold Move didn’t just endorse me;_they supported me._**

Their commitment went beyond words or symbolic gestures. **In a state where the status quo means accepting the highest rates of rape and domestic violence in the country, Her Bold Move understood their responsibility to change that.** They took a stand, knowing this might not be a seat to win this time. They chose bold action over safe bets, proving that their mission wasn’t just rhetoric – it was a promise to women across America.

I’m going into rural Arizona, deep red parts of my state, and holding “Save Medicaid” town halls. I’m showing up. I’m doing it because cuts like these are reckless, they’re dangerous, and we’ve got to stop them.
#

Peter, it’s Ruben Gallego here. Maybe you saw this:
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-mar25.cQPUMp&refcode=em250307-1-f&t=1&akid=3748%2E734936%2Eqvsk78)
Here’s what I think:
If you’re going to stand up and cheer for Donald Trump at a joint address, you should be able to tell your voters why.
If you’re going to vote to rip the heart out of Medicaid and food assistance to give tax breaks to billionaires, you can’t run away from the people you’re hurting.
If you’re going to back up Trump and Elon when they’re firing thousands of employees who administer Social Security, Medicare, and the VA, you better show up and answer some questions about it.
They know what they’re doing — they know it’s unpopular, they know people are pissed, and they’re going to hide and hope nobody holds them accountable for it.
Not on my watch.

_**A message from our sponsor...**_

| | | [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=eb8840ba3486494080406ff256beb030&_e=fRgShMrezVMuQoipJP8TezP56XzUu0SBtM5Ci45Fp08xymbKYV8xBSLEo1806f3sNaVgSiNtPva6DDqGncJVFR5UNZUSz1j2HWhj_mofgoe-EmZhrCRQHLENx_9n5sX_y10zMyqIP6q6w8QpEMnNhiAiU5kDFR5FcPD4toDWFM6kFI9utVzWH6KkxhHlL_RZrnyBnuPkMdijmz8B4T1kVyFi9hH7zG-YvMIM0ANyUs1ZzUAQWkd45D7-G9vnlE8_a2wwS85R4FSPa745jOjJBzIqcNr3IJyQ1tMumWoOGjJAzyRohrogAjen0LCMchf1wbKHFCuYTW6V_zxwYbks7UPW9mLjjzbMjpqEZ8Jo2K1zXQ7HprhJahj-mt9M4bLyuXy8U324ZWqtrmdenmpxsDjQee1FU7g0ELtB3iy5urh78B1GxcIv0m3p_Duzk4KH)

| | Peter,

Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history, can make understanding the most important historical points difficult.

To uncover this fascinating history, we've produced our online course, "[Ancient Christianity](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=eb8840ba3486494080406ff256beb030&_e=fRgShMrezVMuQoipJP8TezP56XzUu0SBtM5Ci45Fp08xymbKYV8xBSLEo1806f3sNaVgSiNtPva6DDqGncJVFR5UNZUSz1j2HWhj_mofgoe-EmZhrCRQHLENx_9n5sX_y10zMyqIP6q6w8QpEMnNhiAiU5kDFR5FcPD4toDWFM6kFI9utVzWH6KkxhHlL_RZrnyBnuPkMdijmz8B4T1kVyFi9hH7zG-YvMIM0ANyUs1ZzUAQWkd45D7-G9vnlE8_a2wwS85R4FSPa745jOjJBzIqcNr3IJyQ1tMumWoOGjKaz8uTKSvp-D9uaLtUP1G4XhDO-Nqvm5Oc479Mx6S8tvNS0wP7v4c05Wp6j4XbUQ_5TTn95xL7BSli1ECSgSK3bekaNYNtPZKAlVd93N3PNsPsC0pl6C6RyuNwSfB375LyH5aH3icHpUj3rwk-ex4w)," now available on DVD.

In this course, Professor Kenneth Calvert is your guide through the first four centuries of Christianity as he explains the remarkable ways the new faith transformed the Roman world.

Would you help support this course so we can make it available to millions of Americans for free? As a token of our appreciation for your support, we'll send you a copy of our beautiful DVD Box Set for any donations of $100 or more.
[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=eb8840ba3486494080406ff256beb030&_e=fRgShMrezVMuQoipJP8TezP56XzUu0SBtM5Ci45Fp08xymbKYV8xBSLEo1806f3sNaVgSiNtPva6DDqGncJVFR5UNZUSz1j2HWhj_mofgoe-EmZhrCRQHLENx_9n5sX_y10zMyqIP6q6w8QpEMnNhiAiU5kDFR5FcPD4toDWFM6kFI9utVzWH6KkxhHlL_RZrnyBnuPkMdijmz8B4T1kVyFi9hH7zG-YvMIM0ANyUs1ZzUAQWkd45D7-G9vnlE8_a2wwS85R4FSPa745jOjJBzIqcNr3IJyQ1tMumWoOGjIVzCkWQNTH-rOljBwwVlKbIu1HREj4s3UaIGUqHgSAjxhIHUmhb38J6GAAsNRyosdm6liRzocDh4dUSXnqZ8TY2ypXvt8h4nrFdnaa4sJBaaKkmgHqUKIlAhhJQJoZSpYxpOdfWFRv1L4ryQ4jIwXc)

| | | | Team,
Right now, our district is under siege. The MAGA machine is flooding the airwaves with attack ads, smearing my name, and twisting the truth - all because they know this seat is winnable for Democrats. They're scared. They know that if we flip this district, we are one step closer to taking back the House.
Republicans have billionaire backers, dark money groups, and corporate PACs fueling their campaign. But I have something much stronger: YOU.
Our campaign is built on people power and grassroots donors from all 50 states who believe in truth, fairness, and the urgent need to defeat right-wing extremism.
We cannot let these attacks go unanswered. Every day, more misinformation spreads, and if we don't have the resources to fight back, they will define this race before we even get to Election Day. But we can only do that if we hit our fundraising goal this week.

name: Andy Biggs
subject: Join Congressman Andy Biggs at the Arizona March for Life!
body:
Hello and happy Friday!

*We invite you to join Congressman Andy Biggs at the Arizona March for
Life! *

Congressman Biggs is an ardent supporter of the right to life. During his
tenure in Congress, he has introduced, cosponsored, and supported many
pro-life initiatives, including bills to:

- Defund Planned Parenthood;
- Establish that life begins at conception;
- End the IRS's treatment of out-of-pocket abortion costs as a
tax-deductible medical expense;
- End chemical abortions;
- Protect the life of infants who survive an abortion;
- and much more!

Congressman Biggs has been a regular participant in the March for Life in
both Washington, DC and Arizona. Join him this year to march for this
important cause!

---|---|---
The past few years have seen the rise of populist movements around the globe that have upended incumbent governments, movements largely fueled by surging inflation. That was certainly the case in the US, where the incumbent party lost the presidency and Senate, but it was also true around the globe in [places](https://substack.com/redirect/4082358a-ae51-4c9f-bf8f-3f7124c7b3cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from the U.K. to Panama to Portugal.
The reason inflation is such a potent issue with the ability to cause monumental political disruption is because of its far-reaching impact. Seemingly overnight, every single person is suddenly poorer as their purchasing power diminishes. The pain isn't evenly spread, of course, with the middle- and lower-classes bearing the brunt much more so than the rich...which effectively makes inflation a regressive tax that is the result of governments borrowing, printing, and spending too much money. Further, the mindless rush to minimize fossil fuel usage only served to make energy more expensive. Everything from the cost of the electricity to produce goods to the cost of the fuel to transport them all went up. There is a recipe - so to speak - that creates inflation, and our government followed it to a T.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..v1VSeVIRqj-rTzVK5boocZjY6sJTNrHKHcvsUnNoD8M?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=158491196)
Here in the U.S., if there is anything that has become symbolic of the inflation still pinching pocketbooks, it's a staple that Americans take for granted: Eggs. Egg prices hit an all-time high in January, with the [average price](https://substack.com/redirect/5c2d5875-83fe-4ace-97b5-6d71c070dc14?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of a dozen Grade A eggs reaching $4.95. This is a 53 percent over January 2024, and the U.S. Department of Agriculture [predicts](https://substack.com/redirect/e4727710-f68f-4ade-be9b-8c7be787b877?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that egg prices will increase 41 percent this year. Instead of geese laying golden eggs, it's chickens.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cc746476-e580-4fa1-a84e-a73aa061e6be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Even more impactful than strings of numbers are the stories in the news every day. Last month, [Waffle House](https://substack.com/redirect/c02148d2-995c-46a7-ae38-36d996fab1de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [D](https://substack.com/redirect/8d40e63f-4c71-47a7-9dd1-5aa491ea2b1f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) _[e](https://substack.com/redirect/8d40e63f-4c71-47a7-9dd1-5aa491ea2b1f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[nny's](https://substack.com/redirect/8d40e63f-4c71-47a7-9dd1-5aa491ea2b1f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) announced surcharges for every egg in an order; some [stores](https://substack.com/redirect/8e49a95c-9c9d-4a69-b092-4ec5465f1459?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) are now limiting how many eggs shoppers can buy. A gallows humor has [sprung up](https://substack.com/redirect/e45ef317-301d-4f6f-9637-40cf64a8a0fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and late night comedians have had some [fun](https://substack.com/redirect/733940fb-0cb0-46c9-bc3e-16b14076b84e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with the topic.
People are now resorting to desperate measures. Some are trying to bring them in over the border - which is illegal - and egg confiscations were up 29%, [according](https://substack.com/redirect/a580381b-a9fc-4462-af50-ba34ff11ee90?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the U.S. Customs and Border Protection. Someone even [stole](https://substack.com/redirect/7feaf96e-e0b8-4543-ad01-490cde92408b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 100,000 eggs from an organic distributer. Funny, perhaps, but also a felony; the eggs are worth about $40,000. If you want to know what as value, look at what people are willing to risk jail to steal.
Like energy, higher egg prices impact far more than just the dairy aisle. Eggs are a common ingredient in everything from baked goods to mayonnaise to pasta. More expensive eggs can make your entire grocery trip more painful.
**So, why are eggs so expensive?** To start, eggs are caught up in the same inflationary spiral as everything else, as I discussed above. The price of everything from chicken feed to freight costs to packaging has gone up, and that has driven up the price of eggs.
In addition, supply shocks also pressure prices. Geopolitical developments, trade wars, natural disasters, and - as we saw not long ago - pandemics can also spark inflation. And when it comes to eggs, a raging avian flu pandemic may be the biggest contributor to rising prices.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..v1VSeVIRqj-rTzVK5boocZjY6sJTNrHKHcvsUnNoD8M?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=158491196)
[H5N1](https://substack.com/redirect/1f922826-30ba-498a-aa73-95e11b914910?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) began decimating chicken flocks in February 2022. Since then, 130 million birds have been affected, making it one of largest such outbreaks in U.S. history. When a commercial poultry farm is [discovered](https://substack.com/redirect/51eea219-22d7-4dbf-a26b-033bbbc4d2a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to have an incidence of the virus, it is placed under quarantine and the transportation of all poultry and egg products is halted. Flocks are culled, and an extensive cleaning, disinfecting, and testing regimen is undertaken before getting USDA and state approvals to re-open.
Given that U.S. commercial poultry outfits are typically large - flocks of 1 million are not uncommon - each outbreak tends to have a large impact on the number of egg-producing hens in the country. After an outbreak is dealt with, it takes more time to repopulate these larger farms and get the flock to egg-laying age. There are just over 300 million egg-laying hens in the U.S., and since last October, 52 million have been [lost](https://substack.com/redirect/9e425620-1bb6-42e1-96eb-f91d01d6c834?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg); that's 17 percent of the total number of hens in the country. Fewer hens mean fewer eggs, and, as taught in Econ 101, when supply can't meet demand, prices rise.
The trendy cage-free movement may be a [factor](https://substack.com/redirect/1991f0c4-4d69-4202-93ef-56f5a91ed3c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as well. In 2018, California - a top egg producer - passed a law mandating that all eggs sold in the state are produced in cage-free environments; eight other states followed suit and now 40 percent of the eggs sold in the U.S. are cage-free, up from just 5 percent in 2010. Cage-free eggs cost more and this, too, has contributed to price increases. But more importantly, there is [evidence](https://substack.com/redirect/9e425620-1bb6-42e1-96eb-f91d01d6c834?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the avian flu hits cage-free facilities harder; although cage-free hens make up only a third of the U.S. flock, they account for 60 percent of all bird flu cases. And like college kids on Spring Break, it's tough to enforce social distancing among free-range hens.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d8fff8dc-94b4-44cf-b26a-fb7999cd18dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Photo by [Daniel Tuttle](https://substack.com/redirect/a6b5c94f-1b08-4319-8fb0-7c3808db8e96?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on [Unsplash](https://substack.com/redirect/17a12a2a-8352-4773-a6db-735a5beb4b58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
So, what can be done to lower prices? Getting the bird flu under control is the obvious place to start, and the USDA has spent nearly $2 billion trying to do exactly that. It's proven easier said than done, and now Trump's Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins has proposed spending another billion. She recently released a [plan](https://substack.com/redirect/45e77c5f-4490-41cb-aec7-928c69b0ad68?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to lower egg prices, which included bio-security measures and exploring vaccines and therapeutics so as to avoid depopulating flocks, and importing eggs to increase supply. She even suggested people should raise their own chickens, something people in my home state of New Hampshire are already doing; it's not uncommon to see eggs offered for sale on Facebook, and one enterprising [couple](https://substack.com/redirect/8b714578-4181-4a33-9503-279f6d2060b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is even renting out their chickens.
High prices and supply shocks can also spur innovation and cultural shifts; just think about Zoom and "working remote". Could the same happen with eggs? Lab-grown meat has been making strides and lab-grown milk will soon make its U.S. [debut](https://substack.com/redirect/b1e5f6b6-96aa-43e5-9fc2-f284d11d26de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg); some [companies](https://substack.com/redirect/67b2e244-a1fa-476a-b1f1-2e4d05e80b59?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) have already developed lab-grown eggs. Other companies have been working on vegan substitutes made from beans, tofu, and lentils that increasingly mimic the real thing. Supply shocks sometime change tastes; Americans' famous predilection for coffee was the result of the lack of British tea during the American Revolution; John Adams once [declared](https://substack.com/redirect/486477c3-3d6a-4c25-93d5-b55649abdbd9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that drinking tea was unpatriotic. Some of these substitutes might take hold if prices remain high enough, for long enough.
While there are things that can marginally improve or worsen the situation, until the avian flu is brought under control and flocks are built back up, until supply-chains are reconnected and general inflation brought back down, egg prices will likely remain high. These things are going to take time. We may very well find out that Humpty Dumpty is hard to put back together again.
