body:
| | | | |
---
| | [](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0012seBklJmk3wpK379m0-SW6da2AFxwBdxTkWxVSzaEoJi1eH5jWqhn04UbgdafCwa4BDCpvbousmLqcIPxtXflC4g-ipH_vnmJwW_kzRXXVxcqse_AVc3LwwHfrVaEP3BMt4tDTCzQBApLYmLFPaTQg==&c=ZLQbjQ5CDIxsMxBnrJPhdcN8LeRT-pUGKmA1fThm1xss5mHDZuvtIw==&ch=18XeWmT8JRHzuKBqgt7jPW8FI7dcdHibajOZSPebRyeI5iaXctyOgA==)
---
| MassGOP Monthly Update: March Edition
---
---
| Friends,
Spring is almost upon us, and the MassGOP is charging ahead with momentum, determination, and a clear vision for the future! As Democrats double down on reckless spending, ignore transparency, and push extreme policies that put taxpayers last, we're standing strong--fighting for accountability, commonsense solutions, and real leadership in Massachusetts. With critical elections on the horizon, candidate trainings in full swing, and grassroots energy growing by the day, we're building a movement that can't be ignored. The fight for our Commonwealth's future is now, and with your support, we will turn the tide. Let's get to work!
Communications:
Back in February, the Democratic supermajority and the Healey-Driscoll Administration chose to further the migrant crisis. The MassGOP, alongside Republican legislators in the House and Senate, [strongly opposed any additional funding for what has become a full-blown humanitarian crisis--demanding meaningful reform instead.](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0012seBklJmk3wpK379m0-SW6da2AFxwBdxTkWxVSzaEoJi1eH5jWqhn8ftIr36McJjlvBGinJohOAXEKSLzbaCh-Y88uHo8W7PER6ztgnNs9YQsVi2R4sXcOv5lVUxepwmBIybHFRcjIswX0Ff57V4sinC2bST9xAtjfF8S--66TLPoJKEt-daw87pBcr7Hcnn-ysa0n00UiM5_KPjoxnIfLQ4WXRzXToxe64tErzxpvrGriLrpBp7DQ==&c=ZLQbjQ5CDIxsMxBnrJPhdcN8LeRT-pUGKmA1fThm1xss5mHDZuvtIw==&ch=18XeWmT8JRHzuKBqgt7jPW8FI7dcdHibajOZSPebRyeI5iaXctyOgA==)
Democrats ended up voting to spend another $425 million of taxpayer money to sustain and expand the migrant crisis--rejecting every Republican effort to bring accountability and common sense to the process. Minority Leader Senator Bruce Tarr (R-Gloucester) proposed an amendment requiring universal background checks for individuals seeking Emergency Assistance (EA) housing, closing a loophole that allows applicants from outside Massachusetts--and even outside the country--to bypass meaningful vetting, yet Democrats blocked it. Senator Peter Durant (R-Spencer) introduced another amendment to prioritize homeless Massachusetts residents over newly arrived migrants, ensuring those who have paid into the system receive first access to taxpayer-funded services, but Democrats rejected that too. By voting to pass this supplemental budget without meaningful reform, [Governor Healey and the Democratic supermajority have doubled down on wasteful spending, ignored public safety concerns, and disrespected hardworking taxpayers--all to appease the most extreme factions of their base.](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0012seBklJmk3wpK379m0-SW6da2AFxwBdxTkWxVSzaEoJi1eH5jWqhn8ftIr36McJjxIG8SZHN_tm93Nydx3czeQpxmo8REVyWh81-znpICjqtyPhbBqOkxPdErO9iH2nh5p-ELJYIV9kWglN6NSqa5Z3H1cdj9ZR8ooun4LWtMy2Zv38I_OAKOP3mwd_fd5Gb5nT9xo3k5jZXt-U1qS2cMRLrAEVtXwEFS_QEhyLBjEwb_7zMmn5Euzf4j7nrTJZFu7HzvyRhDmDSndpaRn-cKjosmc0itTO7&c=ZLQbjQ5CDIxsMxBnrJPhdcN8LeRT-pUGKmA1fThm1xss5mHDZuvtIw==&ch=18XeWmT8JRHzuKBqgt7jPW8FI7dcdHibajOZSPebRyeI5iaXctyOgA==)
It seems like Democrats can't let a month go by without an attack on transparency. In early February, Senate President Karen Spilka once again pushed back on the voter mandated legislative audit that was overwhelmingly passed through a ballot question back in November. We made sure to let Senate President Spilka know exactly where we stand. MassGOP Chair, Amy Carnevale stated, ["The fact that Senate President Spilka and the Democratic supermajority are so resistant to this audit is a red flag."](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0012seBklJmk3wpK379m0-SW6da2AFxwBdxTkWxVSzaEoJi1eH5jWqhn8ftIr36McJjYr0xhO_d5fXV9h8B4YWEf12U6eD3fN1ZIJI4VdVClFH4GhlZD2hDbxJ8xWsQV0CsYYgxUHCS7A1WVO4w24OfzXhT5YdJldr8n0BKC2s4UETNY9mabNrRzaglNRBu4AT7In7401trMYCmJetO4bQ0heKZ7lVi7B5U2lnTSEtY8Mc1n45bNhJffMrGD9-0iLenK4IeOtIu-IXIYNshyx35lez8_NBP4Uulx2iYdiGE3xI=&c=ZLQbjQ5CDIxsMxBnrJPhdcN8LeRT-pUGKmA1fThm1xss5mHDZuvtIw==&ch=18XeWmT8JRHzuKBqgt7jPW8FI7dcdHibajOZSPebRyeI5iaXctyOgA==) The MassGOP will continue to stand in strong support of Auditor Dianna DiZoglio's efforts and the 72% of Massachusetts voters who called for a full audit of the legislature.
Republicans remain steadfast in their commitment to enforcing the state-mandated audit, standing with their constituents by introducing a rule change to grant Auditor DiZoglio the authority to audit the legislature. Predictably, the measure failed in a lopsided 24-127 vote, with every Republican supporting transparency and the Democratic supermajority blocking oversight. The event brought together local Republican Town Committees (RTCs), state committee members, and elected officials to celebrate Abraham Lincoln's enduring principles of unity, freedom, and opportunity. With a strong foundation and growing momentum, Massachusetts Republicans are poised to lead with the values that have guided our nation for centuries. A special thank you to Franklin RTC Chair Dashe Videira and Medway RTC Chair Tim Harris for their outstanding leadership in organizing this incredible event!

| Municipal Spotlight:
When have you heard of a major public project coming in under budget? How about millions of dollars under budget? Well, that's what Taunton Mayor Shaunna O'Connell has done. While the media is full of stories about communities tens of millions over budget with their projects, Taunton's Public Safety Building is coming in $10 million under estimated costs! But that's not the only trend Mayor O'Connell is bucking.
Taunton's tax rate is $2700 below the state average. Have services been cut to the bone to do this? No! Under Mayor O'Connell's leadership 20 percent of the roads in the city have been repaved. She has created new programs to help seniors, established free trash days, started helping hand funds, renovated parks and she is about to open a splash pad for children to name a few accomplishments.
As a fiscal watchdog, Mayor O'Connell has been able to increase the city's grant funding not by 25% or 50% or even 100%, but rather 800%. The city's bond rating is now AA+ one of the highest in the state. Moreover, her city's investment income has grown from $400,000 to $11 million which is the 4th highest in the Commonwealth. So is it no wonder why 179 new businesses registered in Taunton last year!
Mayor O'Connell leaves no stone unturned when it comes to helping the taxpayers.

| RNC Report:
Following a celebratory Inaugural event on January 20th, the Republican National Committee (RNC) has shifted its focus to the 2026 midterm elections--a cycle historically challenging for the party holding the White House.
Chairman Michael Whatley, unanimously re-elected at the January Winter Meeting, is expected to announce key subcommittee appointments aimed at securing a Republican majority and ensuring President Trump can carry out his winning agenda.
In regional elections, National Committeewoman Janet Fogarty was elected to the RNC Executive Committee, and Chair Amy Carnevale was elected to the Resolutions Committee--a position previously held by Janet. They will represent the Northeastern Region, which includes the six New England states, as well as New York, Pennsylvania, Maryland, Delaware, Washington, D.C., Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands. Their leadership on these critical committees allows them to advocate for policies and resources that will strengthen Republican efforts in Massachusetts.
National Committeeman Brad Wyatt has been actively working with the RNC's State Party Strategies team to improve voter data and enhance outreach efforts for Republican candidates. Recognizing the importance of accurate information, he is collaborating with the RNC Data Trust to refine Massachusetts' voter data. In politics, as in computing, "garbage in, garbage out" applies--fresh, precise data is essential for effective voter contact, modeling, and outreach.
With strong representation on key committees and a renewed focus on data integrity, the RNC is positioning itself for success in 2026 and beyond.

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for re-election so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in the United States Senate. The Radical Left has him circled as a prime target to defeat in the 2026 Midterm Elections. Can he count on your support? _

College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces. In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud. In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. body:
Where do you fit in?

|
### **Where do you fit in?**
November 2025 seems like a long way away... but it will be here before you know it and so will 2026. Being a volunteer with the Forward Party is not about protests or responding to every headline in the news, it's about keeping your eyes on the big solutions that can improve government effectiveness in the future. Today there's a lot of groups asking for your time and support, and we want to work with many of them. If you're the kind of person that can take a longer view of the challenges we're facing, there's never been a better time to get involved building the PA Forward Party. While we continue to look for candidates to run in local races in 2025 - maybe running for office isn't for you. Equally important is getting more people just like YOU working to actively build the party. Below are some specific ways you can get involved. **Regional Chairs-** our by-laws dictate that we elect some party leadership every year. We currently are looking for potential candidates in the western half of the state. This is a great opportunity to organize supporters and make a real difference in our organization. **County Chairs-** hold in person events, recruit local candidates to run as Forwardists. Many of you are networking locally anyway, reach out and become your official county chair. **Fundraising Lead-** we run a very efficient organization, but we could do much more with more resources. If you have any experience or familiarity with fundraising, PA Forward needs you. **Communication Team-** our established communication team meets weekly and covers a lot of tasks- including this newsletter. Bring you fresh ideas and experience to improve our messaging, social media presence, website, or graphic design. **Merch Team-** we'd like to develop PA specific merch to make available to our supporters. If you have any interest in making bumper stickers or t-shirts, we'll give you what you need. **Legislative Tracker-** important legislation works it's way through Harrisburg all the time. Follow the news and keep the rest of us informed. **Candidate Research Team-** the 2025 candidate meetings have started, and there is a lot of work coming. We could really use more hands looking at races and finding potential candidates. name: David Hogg (via Democrats.org)
subject: What I’m hearing:
body:
---
Derek, I’m reaching out with a quick request. And no, it’s not for money. I’m just over a month into my new role as DNC Vice Chair, and every single day, I’m hearing from Democrats who are angry and worried about what they’re seeing from the Trump administration. They want to see a strong Democratic Party fighting back. Trust me, so do I. As we work to strengthen our Party, the first step is listening to supporters like you on the best way to move forward. [That’s why I’m asking: Will you take a few minutes to share your feedback? Please, feel free to be as honest as possible about what you want to see from Democrats going forward.](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/share-your-feedback-2025/?refcode=em_20250307_2917_fr&akid=2925%2E22930333%2E9KFjYm) This isn’t one of those surveys where the real purpose is to get you to make a donation. The DNC’s team will be reading each response we receive here, and we will use the information we gather to make an informed decision about the DNC’s next steps. Thank you in advance for sharing your feedback — and more to come soon. David David Hogg
Vice Chair
Democratic National Committee | [](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/share-your-feedback-2025/?amount=3&refcode=em_20250307_2917_fr&akid=2925%2E22930333%2E9KFjYm)

By Illinois Review

SPRINGFIELD – Illinois lawmakers are once again trying to chip away at parental rights, this time going after homeschool families with HB2827, a bill that would force new restrictions and government oversight on those who choose to educate their children at home. For decades, homeschooling families in Illinois have enjoyed the freedom to educate their kids as they see fit, free from bureaucratic interference. But now, lawmakers want to change that with a bill that would require annual reporting, portfolio reviews, and even qualifications for parents who homeschool.
CLICK TO SUBMIT A WITNESS SLIP (https://my.ilga.gov/WitnessSlip/Create/160905?committeeHearingId=21603&LegislationId=160905&LegislationDocumentId=200692&GridCurrentCommittees-page=2&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=1f80b982dc-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823)
For over 70 years, Illinois has been one of the freest states for homeschooling. Parents have had the right to choose their curriculum, pace, and teaching methods without answering to state officials. But HB2827 would strip away those freedoms, placing homeschool families under the watchful eye of the same government that has failed public school students across the state. Instead of fixing Illinois’ broken education system, lawmakers are focused on controlling families who choose to opt out.

| | **The NEGOP invites you to attend the _2025 Nebraska Republican Senators' Recognition Dinner_** Dear Friends,

The 2025 Nebraska Republican Senators’ Recognition Dinner, hosted by the Nebraska Republican Party, will take place on March 27, 2025, at the historic Lincoln Station in Lincoln, Nebraska.

The event, themed "Nebraska: A Call to Greatness", will honor Nebraska's state elected officials, including State Senators, and recognize historical figures from the Nebraska Hall of Fame, such as John J. Pershing, Willa Cather, and Standing Bear.

The Nebraska Hall of Fame recognizes outstanding individuals from the State of Nebraska. Twenty-six bronze busts are located on the second floor of the Nebraska State Capitol to memorialize members of the Hall of Fame.

SEE ALL MEMBERS OF THE HALL OF FAME HERE: [https://history.nebraska.gov/nebraska-hall-of-fame/](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=6e09950a8e&e=25844e23a8)

This special evening provides an opportunity to celebrate Nebraska's leadership and history, while showing appreciation and support for those who serve the state. Attendees can purchase individual tickets or sponsor a table, with tickets available online until March 17, 2025.

# [Tell Trump: Don't make it harder for veterans to get the care they need >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta0568ab7-1b1c-465e-b2f7-aef8c9380ab5/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | Trump is planning to gut the Department of Veterans Affairs by slashing 83,000 jobs, which will throw the VA into a tailspin and could prevent veterans from receiving the care they desperately need. Many of the jobs Trump wants to cut were created during Biden’s administration to help veterans who were exposed to burn pits, Agent Orange, and other toxicities while serving our country. These new employees helped millions of veterans get screened for toxic substances and receive care. But now those programs are at risk, as these cuts will create chaos and hinder the VA’s ability to do their jobs. Our veterans risked their lives to keep our country safe. The least Trump can do is ensure they are given proper healthcare. In less than one month, the most important election since November is happening.
# [](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/2780?t=1&akid=451%2E2563979%2Eb_8sCJ)

Here's the truth:
In less than one month, the most important election since November is happening. It's the Wisconsin Supreme Court race and because the court deals with gerrymandering, nothing less than control of Congress is on the line.
Why does Wisconsin -- a toss-up state -- have 6 members of the House who are Republicans and just 2 who are Democrats? It's ridiculous.
With the state Supreme Court’s role in determining how re-districting works, that can change with this election.
The Democratic candidate in the race has received a huge number of individual donations to fund her campaign. The Republican is backed by an Elon Musk super PAC spending obscene amounts of money. It's not great.
Polls show this is a close race. Razor thin. The result will also be seen as the first big electoral test since the last election. Everyone will be watching.
The DNC can move money and people where they are needed most in these final weeks. But they need the resources to keep up with Elon Musk.

| | Friend,

Have you had enough of soft-on-crime policies that benefit repeat offenders, while hurting victims and endangering our communities? I know I sure have. But so have our neighbors, and they're ready for change.

When extremist politicians tried to close our juvenile jail and release violent offenders into unsecured homes in our neighborhood, I stood up, with all of you, to put a stop to that reckless policy. And we succeeded! My legislation to keep the juvenile jail open passed the council unanimously.
**_[[SIGN UP TO RECEIVE UPDATES AND SUPPORT OUR CAMPAIGN HERE!]](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=ace7e29549&e=77eef70c61)_**
More recently, when transit operators from across King County stood up and said they had had enough of the policy failures creating an environment of extreme danger for bus drivers, I listened. I introduced legislation, at the request of the Amalgamated Transit Union (ATU) Local 587, to create a transit safety task force to develop new ideas for improving safety on public transit and in the communities in which it operates.

I'm honored to announce that, earlier this week, my legislation was passed unanimously by the King County Council. The message our legislation sent was clear-- the days of non-existent fare enforcement, negligible codes of conduct, and minimal police presence on our public transit systems are over.

Now, after years of ignoring the concerns of bus drivers and transit riders, our county government will finally start doing what I have long advocated for: restoring safety and accountability, not just on public transit, but for all residents in King County.

Our work is just beginning, but I can promise you this - with your help, the days of ignoring our public safety crisis are over. Transit operators and King County residents have had enough and asked for our support; they deserve our support, and this legislation is a step in the right direction.

Reagan Dunn

And we succeeded! My legislation to keep the juvenile jail open passed the council unanimously. [[SIGN UP TO RECEIVE UPDATES AND SUPPORT OUR CAMPAIGN HERE!]]() More recently, when transit operators from across King County stood up and said they had had enough of the policy failures creating an environment of extreme danger for bus drivers, I listened. I introduced legislation, at the request of the Amalgamated Transit Union (ATU) Local 587, to create a transit safety task force to develop new ideas for improving safety on public transit and in the communities in which it operates. I'm honored to announce that, earlier this week, my legislation was passed unanimously by the King County Council. The message our legislation sent was clear-- the days of non-existent fare enforcement, negligible codes of conduct, and minimal police presence on our public transit systems are over. Now, after years of ignoring the concerns of bus drivers and transit riders, our county government will finally start doing what I have long advocated for: restoring safety and accountability, not just on public transit, but for all residents in King County. Our work is just beginning, but I can promise you this - with your help, the days of ignoring our public safety crisis are over. | | | |

| | | | Friends,

This week, we recognize the bipartisan efforts in Congress to emphasize continuing U.S. support for Ukraine in the face of Russian aggression, revitalizing America’s shipbuilding industry, and the continued impact of women in military service during Women’s History Month.
---
|
---
| 🇺🇸 🇺🇦 Supporting Ukraine and U.S. Global Leadership

With Honor Action remains committed to supporting strong, principled leadership on national security, including standing by our democratic allies.

⭐️ During a recent interview on 60 Minutes interview,**founding For Country Caucus Co-Chair Rep. Don Bacon** , an Air Force veteran, made it clear that this is not just about foreign policy but a direct U.S. national security concern:

“America’s the leader of the free world. We’re the indispensable power. Nobody can stand up to Russia and China if we’re not a part of that. And Ukraine’s the victim. Putin has made clear that he wants to reestablish his old borders, and that’s not in our national security interest. So, to me, this is a national security issue—also a moral issue.”
---
| [ ](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=3e1bb9cfc2&e=33f53a5b1a)
---
Watch a clip of the interview with Rep. Don Bacon [here](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=9fe4516d59&e=33f53a5b1a).

⭐️ **With Honor Action Advisory Board member General H.R. McMaster** also discussed the U.S.-Ukraine relationship and the broader implications for American security. He emphasized:

“Ukraine’s fight is not just about one country’s sovereignty—it’s about defending democracy against authoritarian aggression.”
| [ ](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=9d2c4e789f&e=33f53a5b1a)
---
Watch a clip of the interview with General McMaster [here](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=ddb5263b69&e=33f53a5b1a).
| ➡ Why does this matter?
* A strong, unified stance against threats to global stability reinforces U.S. credibility and national security.
* Bipartisan veterans in Congress have continued to champion support for Ukraine, recognizing that abandoning allies could embolden adversaries.
* The U.S. has a history of leading with strength, and ensuring Ukraine has the resources to defend itself aligns with America’s long-term security interests.

At With Honor Action, we support leaders who take principled stands and understand that standing by our allies strengthens U.S. security and global stability.
---
|
---
| **🛳️ Rebuilding America’s Shipbuilding Industry**

➡ Why does this matter?

Most global trade moves by sea, yet the United States has fallen far behind in shipbuilding, leaving us reliant on foreign nations for maritime transport. The SHIPS Act aims to rebuild our industrial base, strengthen the U.S. Navy and Merchant Marine, and create high-paying manufacturing jobs.

➡ As Senator Young put it:

“We took our eye off the ball when it comes to shipbuilding. If China decides to restrict cargo on its vessels, it would directly impact our ability to move goods and personnel in times of crisis. We need to regain control of our maritime future.”
---
| [ ](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=a8b9075c96&e=33f53a5b1a)
---
| With Honor Action is proud to stand with bipartisan veteran leaders like Senators Young and Kelly, who are tackling these challenges to keep America strong.
---
|
---
| **🪖 Celebrating Women’s History Month & Women in Service**

Throughout history, women have been breaking barriers, serving with honor, and paving the way for future generations. From those who took on leadership roles in times of war to those who continue to serve today, their dedication has shaped our armed forces and strengthened our democracy.

This Women’s History Month, we honor all women who have served and continue to serve: in the military, in Congress, and beyond.

We are especially grateful for the women veterans of the For Country Caucus, who have carried their public service from the military into Congress. Their leadership ensures that our nation’s veterans, military families, and national security remain top priorities.
---
|
---
| Stay tuned for our weekly tributes to the incredible women of the For Country Caucus. We look forward to kicking off AmeriCorps Week next week with special highlights on our social media!

Thank you for supporting leaders who put country over politics.

Hello Friends, The 83rd Legislative Assembly is underway, and we have hit the ground running! I am honored to represent House District 59 which includes all of Crook County and parts of Jefferson and Deschutes
Counties. I am serving as Vice Chair of the House Committee on Housing, and a member of the Joint Committee on Ways & Means and its Subcommittee on Natural Resources. I look forward to having constructive dialogue and working hard to ensure that rural Oregon is being properly represented in Salem. Please feel free to reach out to my office if you ever need help dealing with state government, have questions about legislation, or simply would like to share concerns or ideas. You can reach me by emailing [rep.vikkibreeseiverson@oregonlegislature.gov](mailto:rep.vikkibreeseiverson@oregonlegislature.gov) or by calling my office at 503-986-1459. It is a pleasure to serve House District 59 and rural Oregon, and I hope to hear from you. -Vikki
# Continued Funding for Oregon Juniper Removal Projects
| | | In much of central and eastern Oregon we have seen a rapid increase in Juniper weeds. This tree is considered invasive. Studies have shown large Juniper weeds can consume somewhere between 25 and 40 gallons per day. In 2023, we passed HB 2010 and one of the things we secured in that bill is a pilot program providing grants to a small number of soil and water districts for Juniper removal. You can read all about our progress on the pilot program [here](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fstorymaps.arcgis.com%2Fstories%2Fa8e48a3cd2174600b6366a9cb78aef31/1/0101019571b88802-0aad3db0-428a-4514-98d3-359d3c0f95d0-000000/NDAVlLlYHNuwsrc-oklEl3DJAIcN7r3qmq0XgMwLyrY=395). I am pleased to report all the soil and water districts involved are well on their way in this pilot program and some have already completed their work. House Bill 3135 is designed to continue the program we started I am proud of the incredible work we have done on Juniper removal. If we want to get real about water conservation, we need to get rid of Juniper. Programs like this pilot will not only conserve water but really create new water. I appreciate everyone who has participated in this pilot program, and all the hard work they are doing to fight the Juniper invasion. I also appreciate the newly formed Central Oregon Caucus who supports HB 3135. My hope is to move this legislation forward to the Ways & Means committee to ensure we get this funding across the finish line.
---|---|---
# Wildfire Hazard Map Update
**Rep. Breese Iverson Statement on Wildfire Maps**
Prineville, OR — As the deadline to file appeals to the State Wildfire Risk Map is approaching and public sentiment has become clear in opposition to these maps, State Representative Vikki Breese Iverson (R-Prineville) has issued the following statement
My district was deeply affected by last year’s wildfire. We need to not only repeal the wildfire maps, but we also need to undo the damage caused by these maps.
I have identified four key policy changes we need to begin repairing the damage:
* Explore every opportunity to incentivize private insurance companies to offer plans to rural Oregonians again;
* Offer tax relief to Oregonians who lost their homes in major wildfires (HB 3139);
* Invoke state coordination to improve federal forest planning; and
* Return management control of our millions of acres of federal forest land to state and local governments (LC 4525).

Rep. Vikki Breese Iverson represents Oregon House District 59 which includes Crook County and parts of Deschutes and Jefferson counties.
**Wildfire Hazard Map Resources:**
If you are affected by the Wildfire Hazard Map and would like to appeal your property's hazard zone assignment, we have provided a link below to ODF's Wildfire Hazard Page with information on the appeals process, appeal FAQ and appeal form. Please note, the deadline to file for your appeal is March 10th, 2025.
As always, my office is available to help and answer questions.
[https://www.oregon.gov/odf/fire/Pages/wildfire-hazard.aspx](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.oregon.gov%2Fodf%2Ffire%2FPages%2Fwildfire-hazard.aspx/1/0101019571b88802-0aad3db0-428a-4514-98d3-359d3c0f95d0-000000/2bKe6Ds98uo-vzTX9tPgWS719u5d6boxeJ8LaNpmdno=395)
# Republicans Are Leading on Housing
Here are my comments regarding Housing from the House Republican Caucus Press Conference;
The cost of housing in Oregon is 22% higher than the national average. Oregonians can’t afford the status quo. The only solution on the table right now is more money for government housing.
Republicans have policies this session which will produce more housing by partnering with the private sector.
The State Economist said that we need 100,000 homes to fill the housing need we have today. To solve this housing crisis is going to require three things: More land, more infrastructure, and streamline regulations.
We need land to build houses. There is not enough buildable land. We have two Republican bills that will immediately open land opportunities. While these won’t solve the whole problem, it’s a start.
We can protect prime farmland and make it simpler for cities to expand their borders to build housing. I have a priority bill forthcoming to achieve just that.
Republicans were key to establishing a program in 2024 to help cities with infrastructure needs to develop more housing. We look forward to expanding on that program this session.
Because we are in a housing emergency, we need to make sure the regulations aren’t the reason we can’t end it. Republicans are evaluating all existing and new regulations with this lens: does it build houses?
Republicans have opportunities for creative solutions to help reduce costs for families and build generational living as well as lending opportunities to open up dollars for first time homebuyers.
Oregonians are increasingly frustrated at the lack of housing opportunities. Republicans have the solutions to get us out of this housing crisis. Billions won’t buy our way out. Oregonians can’t afford it.
Oregonians deserve better.
# Supporting First-Time Homebuyers
House Republicans believe the 75% of Oregonians want to own a detached, single-family home. We are working to find ways to help them achieve their goals.
[HB 3188](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Folis.oregonlegislature.gov%2Fliz%2F2025R1%2FMeasures%2FOverview%2FHB3188/1/0101019571b88802-0aad3db0-428a-4514-98d3-359d3c0f95d0-000000/qPRTcP0Qg-NkO2RpOFzjV4X2psdjL5Zfqwu4VyLQh1w=395) is a great program to help more first-time homebuyers find buying power by reducing mortgage payments. This bipartisan bill creates a loan loss fund which will provide first time homebuyers relief of private mortgage insurance on their mortgage through creative ways for the state to partner with credit unions.
[HB 2316](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Folis.oregonlegislature.gov%2Fliz%2F2025R1%2FMeasures%2FOverview%2FHB2316/1/0101019571b88802-0aad3db0-428a-4514-98d3-359d3c0f95d0-000000/mgO2xdG_GbJCzHbx5maOS8SP8Kzbg4tbX6CyH3I_m0Y=395) creates Home Start lands. In short, this bill directs the state to look at all state-owned lands within and adjacent to UGB’s to be designated in this program and developed and sold to Oregon first time homebuyers.
These are just two examples of specific legislation intended to promote first time homebuyers.
In response to Oregon’s housing crisis, House Republicans are leading the way to provide new programs for home ownership. In addition to these innovative ideas, we are working across the aisle and building to find ways to improve programs currently available such as incubator programs, IDAs, first time homebuyers savings account and flex programs. We are also looking at increasing condominium production, which can be one more starting point for first time homebuyers.
Thank you for reading!

Derek,
FBI Director Kash Patel has only been on the job for two weeks, and he’s already been caught in yet another lie.
According to the FBI Agents Association, Patel agreed that the agency’s deputy director should be a career FBI agent with years of experience. But Patel cheered Trump’s decision to name a right-wing podcaster and rabid conspiracy theorist, Dan Bongino, as deputy director.
Derek, Patel’s inclination to lie is nothing new. He proved during his confirmation hearing that he was willing to say _anything_ to get confirmed.
_Literally anything._
He said under oath that he was unaware of plans to dismiss FBI agents before he was confirmed. That was a lie. FBI whistleblowers revealed that Patel covertly directed those dismissals.
He denied promoting a song from the January 6 Prison Choir (Yes, it’s a real thing) and denied having anything to do with the recording. **That was a lie.** He went on Steve Bannon’s podcast saying, “we mastered it, we went to a studio and recorded it, digitized it.”
He also refused to be transparent about his grand jury testimony to Congress. Patel testified under oath before a grand jury about Trump’s handling of classified documents, but his statements and the Special Counsel’s finding were hidden from Congress during the confirmation process.
**Patel isn’t just a liar, Derek. Now as FBI Director, he also poses a grave threat to the safety and security of the American people.**
He is someone who has called for the arrest of journalists, politicians, and anyone who dares stand up to Donald Trump — including Adam.
He even wrote a children’s book titled _The Plot Against the King_ — featuring characters such as “King Donald,” “Hillary Queenton,” and one particular “shifty knight” who, you guessed it, is Adam.
Patel has had a vendetta against Adam for _years_ because of his work to hold Donald Trump accountable and protect the rule of law — **but that’s not going to stop Adam from fighting for transparency, accountability, and the rule of law.**

## The conservative wish list
If you go back decades -- I'm talking the 1980s and Ronald Reagan, you will start to see the construct of the modern day conservative wish list.
Sure, cutting taxes and reducing government have also been at the top of the list, but specific things like abolishing the Department of Education and making English the official language of the United States started getting added to it.
Year after year, election after election were given excuses why it could not happen. I mean in the times when Republicans controlled all the of the major institutions: the White House, the House and the Senate. There was always some reason why it just could not get over the finish line.
But just elect more of us -- give us more time, more money and trust us, next time we will get to it.
It just never did. Ever.
Now it's different.
The standout out line in President Trump's Joint Address to Congress was "but all we really needed was a new President."
He was right.
The excuses are done...

name: Hillsdale College via Victory Mailings
subject: The future of American education is at stake
body:
Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Unsubscribe
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xul=2qq8ny363wdaxf3eu1ztoj1l9d9u992uwpd9x74gjqrnd2arxwnaklm9m88whjo02emwqixzdd3tt4c60iig1zafp6ibvdpdrc1inzrjv&__stmp=ssrno5&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssrno5&__onlt=t

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6df8ff1uf54cuk80id3kmj6arw3wz3v66sktmuk3ergmtz2wh2gcdnfl6mu7eibmw2i7c2gjuklt92jt5niphqyn9cwmi5dnvmpk8asgd3zee7ye0zv3cp10t4xigi5vsbdispzjkaa2xjedm4njx&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssrno5&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssrno5&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssrno5&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssrno5&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6df8ff1uf54cuk80id3kmj6arfcz3nn418hac84try6iotpmef2pjuprat1nupmbxkfm23qpq1znwr17051td18x0rt3h2byv74f3ukhps3gmuwt7bs7p00ycfv6eol3121xf64wkvbenrtgx20px&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssrno5&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssrno5&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| |
---
| | | Hi, it's Vivek Ramaswamy.

I wanted you to hear this directly from me: _I JUST announced my candidacy for Governor of Ohio. _
---
| [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=c95c37a6b7e14cd9bfbfa1664baf846c&_e=hjgxT9G8UfQvTogzixU0quTUvvA4gV8L7hF8HYf5aGhomGm0G_SJ-gKRafqrALdbvrrhEWL5cO9aCMT_WWHruG2XxD6wOer_0jnAyMaSii99qax59YTdXRn-Du1526vbmVBpILTvBoWwovaeRtVYZ2IAy9VaRa20jLyGCiCZuD2yFPw_o6E0BlC7oagECiwSfIBR0UGA_udSRkXs280GwmfEhUrKY2v0JLNoS5ZjCyLxXvEdUuVNSgOrYkfVnzNSRPPbDeaOfb-uRb0hNquohUfJPeC631r3JMDuGBXNr3lAfFSy6rQu8PmXkWgqEzdwVFqwjj3LOJgM7omwHvK0gjUwnWfpUPBHh7yjMI6CQmI20U3ACbIpqS9W6ZT4D3f9v8ZtHhfKJ36RjUOH--U4ONxFyLgVPxb6GeEWsnehcwb50slYkQusm1w6AtySE_qr)
---
**[In a moment, I'm going to ask you to become a Founding Donor to this historic campaign - but first, I'd like to explain why if you'll indulge me for a moment.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=c95c37a6b7e14cd9bfbfa1664baf846c&_e=hjgxT9G8UfQvTogzixU0quTUvvA4gV8L7hF8HYf5aGhomGm0G_SJ-gKRafqrALdbvrrhEWL5cO9aCMT_WWHruG2XxD6wOer_0jnAyMaSii99qax59YTdXRn-Du1526vbmVBpILTvBoWwovaeRtVYZ2IAy9VaRa20jLyGCiCZuD2yFPw_o6E0BlC7oagECiwSfIBR0UGA_udSRkXs280GwmfEhUrKY2v0JLNoS5ZjCyLxXvEdUuVNSgOrYkfVnzNSRPPbDeaOfb-uRb0hNquohS5Za_4dEdl8N0G8tvAe6-KjNphWr2y7eM1U6LBCq5b4vqWq8W7Bgpy0zQGgEQFH7BwxDY-HvaLFo5EBHAZY4choF4EZVeL64p4Bq_QeZwNRISVL-1IVoQso4Ovz6PDicOhuw9hritlcXMyY5TkjtJ57UrXO9c3ydgdJOJjNIeEm "In a moment, I’m going to ask you to become a Founding Donor to this historic campaign – but first, I’d like to explain why if you’ll indulge me for a moment.")**

---
** WHY RUN NOW? **
---
President Trump winning re-election in November was not just another political victory - it was a seismic realignment for our country. He won every swing state. He improved his vote share of minorities and young voters. We won the House AND Senate. And heck, he even won the popular vote.

---
| [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=c95c37a6b7e14cd9bfbfa1664baf846c&_e=hjgxT9G8UfQvTogzixU0quTUvvA4gV8L7hF8HYf5aGhomGm0G_SJ-gKRafqrALdbvrrhEWL5cO9aCMT_WWHruG2XxD6wOer_0jnAyMaSii99qax59YTdXRn-Du1526vbmVBpILTvBoWwovaeRtVYZ2IAy9VaRa20jLyGCiCZuD2yFPw_o6E0BlC7oagECiwSfIBR0UGA_udSRkXs280GwmfEhUrKY2v0JLNoS5ZjCyLxXvEdUuVNSgOrYkfVnzNSRPPbDeaOfb-uRb0hNquohfoOyNmEjrh7FAAW27eI_U_zE8AhiVPJU-yUQwqH3_s8nQQj2-51bOTSyxSfWnSPyuDhUPGm8w5ss394z5_xeghwndJE47mPi-U0tgh29lqkBvuwl2a13DqYMfkvwTn6JZfslxOurPlr3xVYAGgySYPTo-RMdF4bmH_fAtpVawjh)
---
It was the honor of a lifetime to rally voters in battleground states, campaign on college campuses to turn out Gen-Z for Trump, and promote his America First vision at rally after rally.

---
| [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=c95c37a6b7e14cd9bfbfa1664baf846c&_e=hjgxT9G8UfQvTogzixU0quTUvvA4gV8L7hF8HYf5aGhomGm0G_SJ-gKRafqrALdbvrrhEWL5cO9aCMT_WWHruG2XxD6wOer_0jnAyMaSii99qax59YTdXRn-Du1526vbmVBpILTvBoWwovaeRtVYZ2IAy9VaRa20jLyGCiCZuD2yFPw_o6E0BlC7oagECiwSfIBR0UGA_udSRkXs280GwmfEhUrKY2v0JLNoS5ZjCyLxXvEdUuVNSgOrYkfVnzNSRPPbDeaOfb-uRb0hNquohXpBglOlSMh3uYr0eN74fkzeiZUsJ5u8bR7JdVE7E0wjElOgP45swq4RH_WXZmzSKvTIla6D6DStsVVCnr4zGjIT-68BzBLHlhCDdOmKNFNml8IDLxKeMVZdOA08_IlTpr2mWHzn7NfjzjA2i4d4N0RHtLyw6ycyIoK-gzr_Zbcq)
---
Right now, we have a once-in-a-generation chance to make real, lasting change to the country we know and love. It's an opportunity to not just ticker around the edges of the Federal Government, but to upend it completely.

This is our moment to GUT the managerial bureaucracy, FIRE anyone connected to the weaponization of our own government against us, SLASH the size and scope of the administrative state, and usher in the GOLDEN AGE for America!

But the Deep State is already putting up the fight of its life. They're resisting change at every turn. Make no mistake - we can't afford to squander this historic opportunity. That's why President Trump needs trusted partnerships at the state level RIGHT NOW!

---
** WHY OHIO? **
---
This one's easy. I was born and raised here in the Buckeye State and graduated from St. Xavier - a Catholic high school in Cincinnati. My wife, Apporva, and I live outside Columbus, raising our two boys here. I've started multiple businesses in Ohio. I've also known JD Vance since college and campaigned all over the state for our excellent new Senator, Bernie Moreno.
---
| [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=c95c37a6b7e14cd9bfbfa1664baf846c&_e=hjgxT9G8UfQvTogzixU0quTUvvA4gV8L7hF8HYf5aGhomGm0G_SJ-gKRafqrALdbvrrhEWL5cO9aCMT_WWHruG2XxD6wOer_0jnAyMaSii99qax59YTdXRn-Du1526vbmVBpILTvBoWwovaeRtVYZ2IAy9VaRa20jLyGCiCZuD2yFPw_o6E0BlC7oagECiwSfIBR0UGA_udSRkXs280GwmfEhUrKY2v0JLNoS5ZjCyLxXvEdUuVNSgOrYkfVnzNSRPPbDeaOfb-uRb0hNquohS12XoZlWH-GQwHufamoSyetUdiuyjnu7gTiUI9orjiU56Nkz5C0FNYHA_tw_i_PGyqJtqdTOUba7FkvdANWwKIYuV9-cxunJ10RB6thZuWELSbo4kByCP9Zxx7-b8DaRLhH0aoer8InSoThrA1tstR40uty-DVF2_-lMu0gtH7N)
---
The people here are honest, have steel in their spines, and embody the City on a Hill spirit that our country was founded upon. [As Governor, I'd be honored to represent them and the values they stand for.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=c95c37a6b7e14cd9bfbfa1664baf846c&_e=hjgxT9G8UfQvTogzixU0quTUvvA4gV8L7hF8HYf5aGhomGm0G_SJ-gKRafqrALdbvrrhEWL5cO9aCMT_WWHruG2XxD6wOer_0jnAyMaSii99qax59YTdXRn-Du1526vbmVBpILTvBoWwovaeRtVYZ2IAy9VaRa20jLyGCiCZuD2yFPw_o6E0BlC7oagECiwSfIBR0UGA_udSRkXs280GwmfEhUrKY2v0JLNoS5ZjCyLxXvEdUuVNSgOrYkfVnzNSRPPbDeaOfb-uRb0hNquohUd1OB-N2OyQcbvtNaf9lAr_-XNj0ajabgFH7Bo0DN79x_Qef3tkfb_BRVX53i3ikSf2nBe7gBJfI5KgqEdULDoeSaOgEX6way201YzBEL6c-aIwdYtmZTiSNk8-CoKeMbjJkNtVdFED66VhhZjPTd0BitI_-1D_DjEAS02lOTVf "As Governor, I’d be honored to represent them and the values they stand for.")
---
| [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=c95c37a6b7e14cd9bfbfa1664baf846c&_e=hjgxT9G8UfQvTogzixU0quTUvvA4gV8L7hF8HYf5aGhomGm0G_SJ-gKRafqrALdbvrrhEWL5cO9aCMT_WWHruG2XxD6wOer_0jnAyMaSii99qax59YTdXRn-Du1526vbmVBpILTvBoWwovaeRtVYZ2IAy9VaRa20jLyGCiCZuD2yFPw_o6E0BlC7oagECiwSfIBR0UGA_udSRkXs280GwmfEhUrKY2v0JLNoS5ZjCyLxXvEdUuVNSgOrYkfVnzNSRPPbDeaOfb-uRb0hNquohVH7cAG676DXHx3H9Gr9xHw89EoWYW_5F11-3-fNdpp0jzCx1DWyJbRGN0GDnAdS_CYVGnFgs52mt9_y0TZ3Fy6JBRAUGU5mnQ2eZSpGSKf9-zQKt-nqg-QgYshypPmsPiNT0sGukcj1l-h33zKGvkw8n87LadM1eOuMVeMudv2T)
---
** WHY GOVERNOR? **
---
Having traveled across the country, met with hundreds of politicians, ran multiple businesses, and seen how deals really get cut in The Swamp, I have never been more certain that REAL change only gets done with buy-in at the executive level.

---
| [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=c95c37a6b7e14cd9bfbfa1664baf846c&_e=hjgxT9G8UfQvTogzixU0quTUvvA4gV8L7hF8HYf5aGhomGm0G_SJ-gKRafqrALdbvrrhEWL5cO9aCMT_WWHruG2XxD6wOer_0jnAyMaSii99qax59YTdXRn-Du1526vbmVBpILTvBoWwovaeRtVYZ2IAy9VaRa20jLyGCiCZuD2yFPw_o6E0BlC7oagECiwSfIBR0UGA_udSRkXs280GwmfEhUrKY2v0JLNoS5ZjCyLxXvEdUuVNSgOrYkfVnzNSRPPbDeaOfb-uRb0hNquohUM56ZRmUbXwV1Hg2AP3J0tckDX9YiIEX9r29kEwpdCK565stoF8065Uf1dXavzHuBc9wheSVinw0tz8s-ec623fLwx-lIJCh3B2cH2wLUelu4pQmXQCP1CXJ1QqMyqcFyktWsYCY1l0nli1fuQDDmXOwaD2r7Kup9BSfSMhBmcm)
---

Today is a day to honor the heroes who took a stand and put their lives on the line to demand liberation. [Will you add your name to my petition to commemorate this day and join me in affirming your commitment to racial justice?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/103437425/532165745/1170372534?source=SBD_VF_EM_EN_030725_1_1_BloodySunday&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzY2EzOTMyNi04NGZiLWVmMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vI3mBSdbxoH6uECFcrhBqKGsty_hAJBgpYAUUrVZH5E=&emci=300eea18-84fb-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=3ca39326-84fb-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=799895) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/103437426/532165746/1170372534?source=SBD_VF_EM_EN_030725_1_1_BloodySunday&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzY2EzOTMyNi04NGZiLWVmMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vI3mBSdbxoH6uECFcrhBqKGsty_hAJBgpYAUUrVZH5E=&emci=300eea18-84fb-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=3ca39326-84fb-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=799895)

John Lewis, Martin Luther King, and thousands of nonviolent protestors stood firm in demanding justice. They were beaten, bloodied, and tear gassed for daring to speak out. But they found resolve in the final hymn they sung, echoed by Barack Obama in his speech given on the march’s 50th anniversary –

_No matter what may be the test, God will take care of you.
Lean weary one upon his breast, God will take care of you._

The history of segregation isn’t a faded memory in the distant past. I, and many other Black Americans, lived through it. I attended segregated schools until I was in the 6th grade. In North Carolina, we could not eat in the same restaurants as white people. When we went to the grocery store, we were taught not to look directly at a white person.

Almost everything was separate, nothing was equal. I watched the Civil Rights movement unfold before my eyes. I felt the pain, the struggle, and the triumph of overcoming systemic injustice.

It’s important that we recognize that the struggle for equality and racial justice didn’t end with the Civil Right Act in 1964. But it did pave the way to find power in our voice and to use it for change. That’s part of what led me to serve you in Congress. Today is a day to honor the heroes who took a stand and put their lives on the line to demand liberation. | John Lewis, Martin Luther King, and thousands of nonviolent protestors stood firm in demanding justice. They were beaten, bloodied, and tear gassed for daring to speak out. But they found resolve in the final hymn they sung, echoed by Barack Obama in his speech given on the march’s 50th anniversary – No matter what may be the test, God will take care of you. Lean weary one upon his breast, God will take care of you. The history of segregation isn’t a faded memory in the distant past. I, and many other Black Americans, lived through it. I attended segregated schools until I was in the 6th grade. In North Carolina, we could not eat in the same restaurants as white people. When we went to the grocery store, we were taught not to look directly at a white person. Almost everything was separate, nothing was equal. I watched the Civil Rights movement unfold before my eyes. I felt the pain, the struggle, and the triumph of overcoming systemic injustice. It’s important that we recognize that the struggle for equality and racial justice didn’t end with the Civil Right Act in 1964. But it did pave the way to find power in our voice and to use it for change. That’s part of what led me to serve you in Congress. It’s only by standing up to injustice anywhere that we can secure justice everywhere. This piece will upset some of my readers. But I ask you to read all the way through anyway.
Because my job as a human rights lawyer is not to appease with comfortable lies that enable injustice, but to speak uncomfortable truths and uphold justice above all else--certainly above political parties. The hard truth is that while our Republic is at stake, Democrats are asleep at the wheel. And if we have any hope of surviving this onslaught of fascism, Democrats need to get their house in order--and what happened this week is a perfect example of what I mean. **Let 's Address This.**
**Did you know more than 122,000 activists have subscribed to** _**Let 's Address This?** _**We are doing everything in our power to stave off fascism in the United States. Subscribe and join us.**

Rep Al Green Protests Trump's fascism and plan to gut Medicaid by $880B. Creator: J. Scott Applewhite | Credit: APCopyright: Copyright 2025 The Associated Press.
## With Democrats Like These, Who Needs MAGA?
We expected to face stiff opposition from MAGA Republicans hell bent on gutting Medicaid for 80 million Americans--but we didn't expect Democrats to join MAGA. Yet, that's what happened yesterday when 10 corporate Democrats joined a unanimous MAGA caucus to censure Rep Al Green (TX) for getting in good trouble and confronting Donald Trump during his address to the joint session of Congress. With Democrats willing to do Trump's bidding for him, who needs Republicans?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1f6c0cb8-da9c-4484-bde9-db92c86fb29f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
If you read my [now viral piece fact-checking Trump's address](https://substack.com/redirect/71ea4ed5-db41-4c93-833e-555863ad2b2f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the joint session of Congress, you know Trump spent more time lying than breathing, if that's even possible. Rep Al Green stood up in protest, condemning Trump for his budget bill that guts $880B from Medicaid. A reminder that in addition to the 80 million Americans rely on Medicaid to live, 41% of babies born are born because Medicaid made health insurance affordable. Every member of Congress knows these facts--only Rep Al Green was willing to get in Good Trouble to demand accountability.
And for that act of courage, Rep Green's fellow Democrats stabbed him in the back.
Speaker Johnson immediately had Rep Al Green removed--even though Johnson had no objection in past sessions as Reps of his MAGA Caucus, Rep Boebert and Rep MT Greene loudly heckled President Biden. That hypocrisy notwithstanding, the following day Speaker Johnson held a censure vote to condemn Rep Al Green's courage. It is unsurprising that the party who claims to champion free speech is willing to bring the full power of Congress against anyone who dares raise their voice against injustice.
What is surprising, and sad, however, is that 10 Democrats joined the MAGA Caucus to censure Rep Al Green. What's just as sad is that Democratic leadership then reportedly [confronted every Democrat who protested at all, ](https://substack.com/redirect/a8714e72-dad9-4678-8cc9-8ed606b5b2cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)to lecture them on why rules and decorum are important.
## Democratic Leadership Must Listen to Voters or Lose Again
I do not know what reality they're living in. But in case they were unaware, we are facing an existential crisis to our Republic with a fascist in the White House [who is laying the groundwork to commit war crimes](https://substack.com/redirect/09726f6a-96ac-4305-b212-3693f9e3a90e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), has control of the House, the Senate, the Supreme Court, and the backing of every major tech billionaire oligarch in the country. And rather than present any form of a comprehensive plan to counter this impending demise of our democracy--Democratic leadership is lecturing the very Democrats sounding the alarm about rules and decorum. Unbelievable.
And worst of all, they think this strategy is popular with voters. In reality, a new [Quinnipiac University poll found that](https://substack.com/redirect/2abd5be0-2605-42c0-98a1-8d18c8dccd02?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at 21%, Democrats have the lowest approval rating in history, while at 40%, Republicans have the highest approval in history.
The stubbornness and refusal to change will do nothing but contribute to our Republic's collapse.
The Democratic strategy hasn't worked, and voters are telling them it hasn't worked. Democrats need to either listen to voters, or expect to lose election after election. We must make them listen, and while I loathe to spend precious time having to remind Democrats about why democracy matters, justice demands we continue to speak truth to power no matter what. So here's today's call to action.

## Remind Democrats that Fascism is Bad and Democracy is Good
Here are the 10 Democrats who voted with MAGA to censure Rep Al Green for loudly rebuking Trump's fascist plan to gut Medicaid:
•Ami Bera (CA) 202-225-5716
•Jim Costa (CA) 202-225-3341
•Jim Himes (CT) 202-225-5541
•Jared Moskowitz (FL) 202-225-3001
•Ed Case (HI) 202-225-2726
•Laura Gillen (NY) 202-225-5516
•Tom Suozzi (NY) 202-225-3335
•Marcy Kaptur (OH) 202-225-4146
•Chrissy Houlahan (PA) 202-225-4315
•Marie Gluesenkamp Perez (WA) 202-225-3536
It was bad enough that they did not have the courage to do anything more than hold up a silly sign or dress in pink to protest Trump's fascism, but to tear down the one single Democrat willing to get into Good Trouble to oppose fascism? Spineless. I encourage you to contact each office and let them know you do not approve of them censuring a fellow Democrat for standing up to Trump, and that you want to see them actually fight for our Republic, rather than join MAGAs in beating our Republic to death. Remind them that their cowardice is why Democrats currently have the worst approval rating in history, while the fascist they're supposed to oppose has an approval rating more than double theirs.
AND FINALLY, I also encourage you to call Rep Al Green's office at (202) 225-7508. Call and thank him for standing up for Medicaid and against fascism. It is critically important we let our elected officials know when we are proud of them. To his immense credit, despite the censure, Rep Al Green stated he would protest Trump again given the opportunity to do so. We need more Al Green's in Congress.
## Conclusion
This following statement should not upset anyone committed to justice: Democrats cannot afford to play by outdated rules while Republicans wage an all-out assault on democracy. The censure of Rep Al Green is more than just a betrayal--it's a symptom of a party that refuses to recognize the urgency of this moment. Fascism does not care for decorum, and history will not look kindly on those who stood by in silence. We must demand better of our elected officials, and call them to uphold justice above all else. If Democrats want to remain relevant, they must stop policing their own and start fighting for the people who elected them. Call your representatives. Demand courage. Justice is not passive--it requires action, and the time to act is now.
**Join our fight for justice. Subscribe below and join the movement.**

name: Josh Weil
subject: The GOP is Underestimating Us
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Dear friend,

This is Josh Weil, FL-6 candidate, and father to two boys. Lately I have been thinking about how our state has been shaped, and how I can best serve you in office. [**We only have 4 weeks to make our goals a reality this special election cycle, and I cannot stress enough how important it is we work together.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/87723?t=6&akid=19165%2E878179%2EYsBGEI)

It has been five years since COVID-19 first reshaped our lives, and Florida is still feeling the impact. The pandemic exposed deep vulnerabilities in our public health system, economy, and education. Instead of learning from the crisis, our state and federal leadership has **doubled down on partisan culture wars, prioritizing power over people.**

Governor DeSantis used emergency powers during the pandemic to consolidate authority, a pattern _that has continued beyond the crisis._ His administration has weakened public health policies, undermined trust in science, and fostered extreme partisanship—all while taking credit for federal relief funds he once opposed. Now, with those funds gone, Florida faces economic uncertainty. On top of that, Trump and Musk have destroyed the integrity of our federal jobs.

Education has also suffered. Pandemic disruptions led to declines in student performance, and instead of addressing these challenges, state leaders expanded private school vouchers, diverting billions from public schools. Meanwhile, partisan attacks on curriculum and school boards have made education more divisive than ever. **As an educator, this has become an integral part of my platform for a reason, and it is because I have seen this first hand within my district.

The pandemic accelerated political shifts in Florida, turning it from a battleground state into a Republican stronghold.** However, that does not mean we should give up on fighting for accountability, transparency, and policies that put people first.

[**To be frank, I need your help. Considering Florida’s chronology, our campaign has been continually tag-teamed by Trump and the GOP - let’s flip this seat and show them up. Click to donate $10 split between me and Voter Protection Project and support a campaign that is fighting for our future, despite our past.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/87724?t=7&akid=19165%2E878179%2EYsBGEI) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Josh Weil and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/87725?t=8&akid=19165%2E878179%2EYsBGEI)

As an educator and congressional candidate, I believe we must prioritize rebuilding trust in our institutions, investing in education, and ensuring our government serves its citizens—not just political ambitions. We have the opportunity to shape a future that learns from past mistakes instead of repeating them.

Let’s work together to build a Florida that puts people first. If you’re ready for leadership that fights for all Floridians, I hope to earn your support.

Peter,
# “It is our duty to fight for our freedom. It is our duty to win.”
In 2025, these words of Assata Shakur are guiding us. We are fighting to win. I know this is a long email, but it’s important. One PA stands on the frontline to protect our rights and democracy, put people before profit, and build power in our communities for affordable housing, good jobs, and clean air and water. _**[If you’re ready to support the work of building power in Black and multiracial working class communities to win social and economic justice, we need you now more than ever.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/103439535/532172823/833574030?refcode=EM_FL_OPA_20250307_fr_vision_cm_oc_act_xx_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzY2MTk3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjAxMjcwOWJmLTg3ZmItZWYxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=rIZ0jyy0wGm3rL8o-k34PQ5CLY8wJvISmEmBBuRiOR8=)**_ | [Let’s fight to win >>](https://click.everyaction.com/k/103439536/532172824/833574030?refcode=EM_FL_OPA_20250307_fr_vision_cm_oc_act_xx_sbt1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzY2MTk3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjAxMjcwOWJmLTg3ZmItZWYxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=rIZ0jyy0wGm3rL8o-k34PQ5CLY8wJvISmEmBBuRiOR8=)
---
There is no settled recipe for building power or winning. Each cycle, campaign, and program is an opportunity for us to study how conditions are changing and how we can improve our work.
2024 taught us a lot.
* We saw the blunt cumulative impact of many years of the social, political and economic disinvestment from Black and multiracial working class communities.

* Having no Primary stripped the Democrats of a vital source of insight about the needs of American people. We need to address the cost-of-living crisis head on AND push back against the scapegoating of immigrants, trans people and communities of Color.

* Civic institutions have withered over time, and Democratic governance has struggled to meet people’s material needs.

* Cities, where most of our base live, are particularly difficult to live in.

* The internet is more than a place to purchase ads and micro-influencer plugs, it is also a key area where ideas are struggled over. We can’t just buy new media, we need to also _earn_ it.

* We need to build long-term structure-based civic organizations at the local level. Having a high volume of canvassing conversations on doors is important, but not enough on its own.

People have felt varying degrees of rightful cynicism, disgust with feeling taken for granted, desperation and nihilism.
_**[We’re confident that the solution to each of these challenges is through structure based organizing and strategic storytelling — that’s just what we do at One PA. Help support the long and difficult work that’s needed now more than ever.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/103439537/532172825/833574030?refcode=EM_FL_OPA_20250307_fr_vision_cm_oc_act_xx_l2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzY2MTk3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjAxMjcwOWJmLTg3ZmItZWYxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=rIZ0jyy0wGm3rL8o-k34PQ5CLY8wJvISmEmBBuRiOR8=)**_

What we have planned so far for 2025 and 2026, if we have the resources.
* **Resistance is fundamental.** We will continue to help build public mobilizations, across our communities, and at the offices of GOP legislators; we will continue to support our members to stand up and speak out against Project 2025 in ways big and small. When people are in motion, and resisting in the street, it brings the goalposts closer for all our other goals.

* **Breaking up Trump’s Majority** \- Four Pennsylvania Republicans who will be critical for Trump's majority: Senator Dave McCormick, Rep Ryan Mackenzie (PA-07), Rep Rob Bresnahan (PA-08) and Rep Scott Perry (PA-10). Each won their seat by less than 1%. One PA will strategically build and mobilize a base to force McCormick and Perry to choose between denying Trump his majority and making their reelection unwinnable.

* **State and Local Policy for Community Defense** — Local leaders are facing pressure to roll back policies, like noncooperation with ICE, or stay on the sidelines as new attacks from Trump’s Administration unfold. We have a critical responsibility to help waffling leaders find courage to stand strong in opposition to legal, physical, and rhetorical assaults, as well as to pass new and innovative policy to close the gap left by shrinking federal protections.

* **Protecting Progressive Local Leaders and the State Supreme Court** — We currently have a 5-2 balance on the State Supreme Court, favoring pro-democracy judges, but three of the five pro-democracy judges have terms expiring this year. If we do not protect at least two of these three seats in 2025, we will lose the state court.

What’s more, Pittsburgh’s progressive mayor and Philadelphia’s progressive District Attorney are both being targeted by the GOP, to be taken out in the Democratic primary, this May. We will work to keep GOP money from meddling in Democratic primaries, and protect these incumbent allies who are committed to centering working class communities of Color and making real solutions.

* **Corporate Campaigns, Budget Campaigns, and Advocacy Campaigns** — We know that electoral tactics are just a small part of building power. We will continue to organize against large scale corporations and advocate for progressive policies from solving the housing crisis, curbing environmental racism, expanding voting rights, safeguarding immigrants at the state and local level, and more.

* **Quality vs. Quantity and Lasting Infrastructure** — What would it look like to quantify, validate, resource, and scale the civic power of organizing? We are focusing on quality conversations in the community early, digging in on the pipeline of voters-to-One PA members, and growing our independent voice online and in person to broadcast what is needed in this moment to fix this country with the clarity for impact.

We’ve been at this for a long time, and we stand on the shoulders of those who have been doing this for many years and generations before us. There’s important work left to do, and that’s what we’re focused on right now.

clean_body: It is our duty to fight for our freedom. It is our duty to win.” In 2025, these word of Assata Shakur are guiding us. We are fighting to win. | = Peter, “It is our duty to fight for our freedom. It is our duty to win.” In 2025, these words of Assata Shakur are guiding us. We are fighting to win. I know this is a long email, but it’s important. One PA stands on the frontline to protect our rights and democracy, put people before profit, and build power in our communities for affordable housing, good jobs, and clean air and water. = | = There is no settled recipe for building power or winning. Each cycle, campaign, and program is an opportunity for us to study how conditions are changing and how we can improve our work. 2024 taught us a lot. We saw the blunt cumulative impact of many years of the social, political and economic disinvestment from Black and multiracial working class communities. Having no Primary stripped the Democrats of a vital source of insight about the needs of American people. We need to address the cost-of-living crisis head on AND push back against the scapegoating of immigrants, trans people and communities of Color. Civic institutions have withered over time, and Democratic governance has struggled to meet people’s material needs. Cities, where most of our base live, are particularly difficult to live in. The internet is more than a place to purchase ads and micro-influencer plugs, it is also a key area where ideas are struggled over. We can’t just buy new media, we need to also earn it. We need to build long-term structure-based civic organizations at the local level. Having a high volume of canvassing conversations on doors is important, but not enough on its own. People have felt varying degrees of rightful cynicism, disgust with feeling taken for granted, desperation and nihilism. = = What we have planned so far for 2025 and 2026, if we have the resources. Resistance is fundamental. We will continue to help build public mobilizations, across our communities, and at the offices of GOP legislators; we will continue to support our members to stand up and speak out against Project 2025 in ways big and small. When people are in motion, and resisting in the street, it brings the goalposts closer for all our other goals. Breaking up Trump’s Majority \- Four Pennsylvania Republicans who will be critical for Trump's majority: Senator Dave McCormick, Rep Ryan Mackenzie (PA-07), Rep Rob Bresnahan (PA-08) and Rep Scott Perry (PA-10). Each won their seat by less than 1%. One PA will strategically build and mobilize a base to force McCormick and Perry to choose between denying Trump his majority and making their reelection unwinnable. State and Local Policy for Community Defense — Local leaders are facing pressure to roll back policies, like noncooperation with ICE, or stay on the sidelines as new attacks from Trump’s Administration unfold. We have a critical responsibility to help waffling leaders find courage to stand strong in opposition to legal, physical, and rhetorical assaults, as well as to pass new and innovative policy to close the gap left by shrinking federal protections. Protecting Progressive Local Leaders and the State Supreme Court — We currently have a 5-2 balance on the State Supreme Court, favoring pro-democracy judges, but three of the five pro-democracy judges have terms expiring this year. If we do not protect at least two of these three seats in 2025, we will lose the state court. What’s more, Pittsburgh’s progressive mayor and Philadelphia’s progressive District Attorney are both being targeted by the GOP, to be taken out in the Democratic primary, this May. We will work to keep GOP money from meddling in Democratic primaries, and protect these incumbent allies who are committed to centering working class communities of Color and making real solutions. Corporate Campaigns, Budget Campaigns, and Advocacy Campaigns — We know that electoral tactics are just a small part of building power. We will continue to organize against large scale corporations and advocate for progressive policies from solving the housing crisis, curbing environmental racism, expanding voting rights, safeguarding immigrants at the state and local level, and more. Quality vs. Quantity and Lasting Infrastructure — What would it look like to quantify, validate, resource, and scale the civic power of organizing? We are focusing on quality conversations in the community early, digging in on the pipeline of voters-to-One PA members, and growing our independent voice online and in person to broadcast what is needed in this moment to fix this country with the clarity for impact. We’ve been at this for a long time, and we stand on the shoulders of those who have been doing this for many years and generations before us. | Dear Congressman Al Green,

I am writing to express my deep disappointment and outrage at your shameful behavior during the State of the Nation. Your decision to interrupt this sacred institution was a slap in the face to the millions of Americans who voted to put America First once again.

Your actions were a stark reminder of the disrespect and contempt that many Democrats have for our country and its institutions. It's unacceptable that you would use this moment to grandstand and score cheap political points.

I demand that you apologize to the American people for your boorish behavior. Your actions were not only a disservice to the office of the President, but also to the country as a whole.

Furthermore, I call on your colleagues in the Democratic Party to condemn your actions and take steps to ensure that such disrespect is not tolerated in the future.

Make no mistake, Congressman, the American people will not forget your behavior. We will remember your lack of respect and decorum, and we will hold you accountable for your actions.

The America First movement will not be deterred by your attempts to disrupt and undermine our efforts. We will continue to stand strong and united in support of our values and our country.

Sincerely,
