subject: Jim Jordan is using our tax dollars to tear up the Constitution
body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
I wish I could say I was surprised.
But when it comes to presidential abuse of power, Jim Jordan is doing what he does best—cheering it on.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250307_jordan_rejects_constitution_image [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250307_jordan_rejects_constitution_image]
There was a time when Republicans stood up for the Constitution.
After Nixon’s Watergate scandal, both parties came together to curb executive overreach.
They passed laws ensuring presidents couldn’t just funnel money however they wanted or fire government watchdogs who keep them in check.
But now?
The modern GOP (the ULTRA-MAGA Party) has decided that their loyalty isn’t to America, the rule of law, or even their own constituents—it’s to one convicted felon.
And Jim Jordan is leading the charge.
We need to fight back. I’m not in this race to sit on the sidelines while Jordan sells out our democracy to an autocrat. If you want someone in Congress who believes in accountability, checks and balances, and actually doing their job—rush a contribution right now to help us take the fight directly to Jordan. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250307_jordan_rejects_constitution_link]
Trump is firing inspectors general, withholding congressionally approved funds, and openly defying court orders.
Jim Jordan is not just ignoring it—he’s defending it.
He outright mocked the idea that there should be any limits on presidential power, because in his mind, Trump is king, and Congress exists to serve him.
But should we really be surprised?
Jim Jordan has always protected abusers in power.
When a predator was sexually abusing student-athletes at Ohio State, Jim Jordan didn’t step in—he turned a blind eye.
Multiple wrestlers say he knew, he heard what was happening, and he did nothing to stop it.
So it’s no surprise that now, as Trump tramples over the Constitution, Jordan is once again refusing to stand up and do what’s right.
This is the same man who has never passed a single bill in his 18 years in Congress.
The only thing he’s ever been good at is running political stunts and protecting powerful men from consequences.
That’s not leadership. That’s the lowest form of cowardice.
And it’s why we have to beat him. If you’re as tired as I am of watching Jordan cozy up to corruption, let’s upend his future together. Chip in today to help me take him on and win. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250307_jordan_rejects_constitution_link2]
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

subject: How you can stand up against Trump and Musk:
body:
You have a decision to make, Peter. | | | **Peter,****there are moments in history that make us question what we would have done if we had been alive then.** **We’re living through one of those moments right now.** You have a decision to make: Be part of the resistance or allow Trump and his allies to continue villainizing our immigrant communities and putting corporations above working-class people. Left and right, Trump and unelected billionaire Elon Musk have:
* Fired _thousands_ of federal workers who protect our national parks, provide care to our veterans, and conduct crucial cancer research. _Source: Routers_

* Threatened to remove and impeach federal judges who stand in their way. _Source: The New York Times_ _
_
* Cut back protections and attacked birthright citizenship for children of immigrants, putting people in our communities at risk of being abducted from their families — **unless you have $5 MILLION to spare, of course!**
__

In barely 45 days, Trump and Musk have tried to crush dissent and create a clear path to tear our communities apart! While millions are struggling to make ends meet, the President and his wealthy buddy have been leading major layoffs and pushing to cut back essential programs for our community — all while advocating for tax cuts for the rich. We need to wake up and stop Trump’s lies. Immigrants are your neighbors, friends, and family who, just like you, are trying to make ends meet in a country being run by unethical billionaires! **In case we didn’t make it clear: we’re not backing down.** So, what can you do to channel your anger and disappointment into real change for our communities? [**You can start by joining our Here to Stay Network to learn how you can be a force of resistance against Trump’s attempts to tear our families and communities apart!**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.v2UrIOJHHKkg0Pk-aGvhyzCKAdQv6ANAIbZ_2K5v_dC91rsipD286ESFr9EvsYLUJig4VkQHgcNi6qJi15c52UC2z18qI6TILBaTzq8T1AJtUMDtZQboQYYZ7-M0hYJQ5nCeitlCnAp6anFUtToYaPTrMW5J6tw_qZQhqkL_35ISVA6eJLs9v27gWOGcXYhaE3sklPumFqsXSyMQg9djgobLxmnDe-6C-iRJUAglG0XOyjXEJ1owZ5qq9cVTkHy4UTiCJfVlf8YHsAxQxcbR1Sr47hD2fwY9KTmCC5K-8HDbsEbldNGpC-mykx9-_S_k/4el/nS0ZXTlFT_m4DbVnOx4G1A/h0/h001.OKoFE0Oo-5ZcqQNsgjgvLxFoPmc59QEwVXnOWM7RrTs) From the moment we heard the results on election night, allies from all across the country tapped into our Here to Stay Network to fight for the future our communities need! We’re fighting back, and we need you, your friends, your classmates, and all people of conscience in your life to join us in standing up for immigrants! clean_body: You have a decision to make, Peter. | | | Peter,there are moments in history that make us question what we would have done if we had been alive then. We’re living through one of those moments right now. You have a decision to make: Be part of the resistance or allow Trump and his allies to continue villainizing our immigrant communities and putting corporations above working-class people. Left and right, Trump and unelected billionaire Elon Musk have: Fired thousands of federal workers who protect our national parks, provide care to our veterans, and conduct crucial cancer research. Source: Routers Threatened to remove and impeach federal judges who stand in their way. Source: The New York Times Cut back protections and attacked birthright citizenship for children of immigrants, putting people in our communities at risk of being abducted from their families — unless you have $5 MILLION to spare, of course! In barely 45 days, Trump and Musk have tried to crush dissent and create a clear path to tear our communities apart! While millions are struggling to make ends meet, the President and his wealthy buddy have been leading major layoffs and pushing to cut back essential programs for our community — all while advocating for tax cuts for the rich. We need to wake up and stop Trump’s lies. Immigrants are your neighbors, friends, and family who, just like you, are trying to make ends meet in a country being run by unethical billionaires! In case we didn’t make it clear: we’re not backing down. So, what can you do to channel your anger and disappointment into real change for our communities? From the moment we heard the results on election night, allies from all across the country tapped into our Here to Stay Network to fight for the future our communities need! We’re fighting back, and we need you, your friends, your classmates, and all people of conscience in your life to join us in standing up for immigrants! Our Network has been driving calls to Congress, sharing Know Your Rights resources with our loved ones, and doing all in our power to have each other’s backs. So, ready to jump into action with us? Start by signing up for our Here to Stay Network and inviting three of your friends to join you: ** Remember: real power comes from our community — not those trying to disrupt our lives and take away the people we love, care for, and spend time with. ✊ In power! Peter, unlike many of my colleagues, the importance of social safety nets like Medicaid and SNAP is _not abstract_ to me.

Growing up in public housing in the Bronx, it was _these_ programs that kept me and my neighbors alive. My mom worked multiple jobs on minimum wage to provide for our family. We relied on programs like public housing and government assistance to get by.

**I know firsthand what these cuts mean for many Americans, and I’m disgusted that my Republican colleagues voted to hurt so many families.**

But Peter, I refuse to sit back and watch the GOP destroy the livelihoods of some of the hardest working people in America. **[That’s why I want to know if you’re with me: Will you add your name to say NO CUTS to Medicaid? »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/103441677/532179532/-39005751?refcode=RTFC_20250307_EMPET_E1_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NjcwODFhNC04Y2ZiLWVmMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OTGmKnwiSQS489-hcluFfGH2lCxanQ2npYMdmL3H0w8=&emci=41160538-fffa-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=467081a4-8cfb-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=34594689)**

| | **2024 was the hottest year on record, and across the country, Americans are struggling with the impacts of climate chaos on a daily basis.** Out-of-control wildfires are blanketing our communities with air pollution, extreme drought threatens our food supply, and intensifying storms inflict record-setting flooding and damage. During Tuesday night's Joint Address to Congress, Trump again repeated his plan to "drill baby drill," signaling that the impacts of climate chaos will likely get worse over the next few years, not better. **_The bottom line is we can't keep living like this if we want a sustainable future._** **Everyone in every corner of Oregon—and across the country—deserves clean air, clean water, and protection from climate chaos.** Unfortunately, the dismantling of environmental justice efforts by Trump and an administration filled with fossil fuel cronies has left our most vulnerable communities exposed to even greater risks. That's why I am working to pass _The Empowering and Enforcing Environmental Justice Act_. This bill permanently establishes the Office of Environmental Justice and codifies vital environmental protections, holds polluters accountable, and ensures that every community, especially those most impacted by climate disasters and toxic pollution, has the necessary tools to secure a healthier, safer future. **The stakes couldn't be higher for the future of our planet** , and I'll never stop pushing for strong legislation that builds a cleaner, greener future. | Peter,

The maternal health crisis in the U.S. is dire—and Black women are disproportionately affected. That is why the Center for Reproductive Rights partners with the [**Black Mamas Matter Alliance (BMMA)**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/103444024/532187210/-219804088?sourceid=1150499&utm_campaign=25emcus-0302aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=bmma&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNjRmNDRkOS05MGZiLWVmMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NIWNlRkQ1dWqbTDFePSK7vBZhUhzU5vMblVCeiHMbKk=&emci=3b7e2967-cffa-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=164f44d9-90fb-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=954237), centering the scholarship and activism of Black women who have been leading the way in sexual, maternal, and reproductive health care.

BMMA's work is crucial as we face new challenges from the anti-rights movement. They lead with innovative research, policy proposals, and educational resources—inspiring collective action in the fight for racial and birth justice.
> _"Our power isn't new, and it certainly isn't going anywhere. Through every storm, every setback, every closed door—**we're still here, still rising**."
> – Black Mamas Matter Alliance_
The Center advances maternal health equity through our Maternal Health & Rights Initiative. We successfully extended Medicaid coverage to 12 months postpartum in nearly all states. Now we’re working to remove legal barriers for skilled midwives, expand access to high quality maternity care, and address pervasive racism in the health care system.

**_Black women deserve to live in a world where they have the rights, respect, and resources they need to thrive before, during, and after pregnancy_ (BMMA)—let's make that world a reality together.**

[**Learn more about BMMA and their important work here.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/103444025/532187211/-219804088?sourceid=1150499&utm_campaign=25emcus-0302aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=bmma&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNjRmNDRkOS05MGZiLWVmMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NIWNlRkQ1dWqbTDFePSK7vBZhUhzU5vMblVCeiHMbKk=&emci=3b7e2967-cffa-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=164f44d9-90fb-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=954237)

Onward,

Breana Lipscomb
Senior Advisor, Maternal Health & Rights

That is why the Center for Reproductive Rights partners with the , centering the scholarship and activism of Black women who have been leading the way in sexual, maternal, and reproductive health care. BMMA's work is crucial as we face new challenges from the anti-rights movement. They lead with innovative research, policy proposals, and educational resources—inspiring collective action in the fight for racial and birth justice. "Our power isn't new, and it certainly isn't going anywhere. Through every storm, every setback, every closed door—we're still here, still rising." – Black Mamas Matter Alliance The Center advances maternal health equity through our Maternal Health & Rights Initiative. We successfully extended Medicaid coverage to 12 months postpartum in nearly all states. Now we’re working to remove legal barriers for skilled midwives, expand access to high quality maternity care, and address pervasive racism in the health care system. Black women deserve to live in a world where they have the rights, respect, and resources they need to thrive before, during, and after pregnancy (BMMA)—let's make that world a reality together. # “I am excited to join the Caltrain Board of Directors and contribute to the amazing work that has been accomplished”
# **\- President David Canepa**
---
| | | | **2025 March e-newsletter** **Board prioritizes fire mitigation and response at annual retreat** Dear friends, It was a productive day for the San Mateo County Board of Supervisors as we held our yearly retreat at the College of San Mateo Tuesday, March 4. As President of the Board, I collaborated with retreat facilitator Jim Delia to conduct a forum aimed at providing solid direction and achievable goals for the County Executive’s Office to execute over the next two years. We discussed how to better address housing and affordability in the county, the future of AI and its potential, wildfire response and emergency preparedness and the upcoming two-year budget process. During the retreat, the Board directed county staff to develop a comprehensive plan to improve fire and emergency response, wildfire mitigation, technology and Zone Zero defensible safe strategies in our urban areas. Special thanks to San Mateo County Cal Fire Chief Jonathan Cox for outlining the steps being taken currently to mitigate wildfires and what the county can do in the future to protect us all during emergencies. We saw with the devastating CZU Lightning Strike Fire in 2020 that polluted our air for weeks and destroyed 80,000 acres, including 1,800 acres in Pescadero Creek, that our county is not immune to wildfires and that we must be prepared for similar tragic events moving forward. **A message to first responders: Your mental health matters** The Board of Supervisors unanimously passed a resolution I sponsored Tuesday, Feb. 25 expressing the county’s commitment to the mental health and well-being of first responders, including firefighters, police officers, emergency medical technicians and paramedics. Special thanks to Supervisor Lisa Gauthier for cosponsoring the resolution and introducing firefighters and personnel from the Menlo Park Fire Protection District, who assisted in recovery efforts in the recent wildfires in Los Angeles and spoke about the district’s robust wellness program [https://stories.opengov.com/menlofireca/published/jcQcUcdX8](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=f1be7b2c1c&e=c0babbc643 "https://stories.opengov.com/menlofireca/published/jcQcUcdX8"). The scenes of horror first responders face routinely can have severe impacts on their mental health, but many do not seek help because of stigma or fears or repercussions. The data shows that those with professions who rush to danger experience higher rates of PTSD, behavioral health issues and experience mental health symptoms related to their work. Recognizing these unique pressures, as policymakers, we must equip our first responders with the tools to manage stress, trauma and mental health challenges effectively. Those who protect and serve our communities deserve this commitment. Thanks to the speakers, pictured above from left to right, Jason Martin, who oversees Menlo Park Fire’s wellness program; Menlo Fire Chief Mark Lorenzen; Virginia Chang Kiraly, a Menlo Fire District director; Tom Calvert, a retired Menlo Fire battalion chief who started the district’s wellness program; and Christine Hollender, a volunteer with First Responder Therapy Dogs alongside therapy dog Garrett [https://firstrespondertherapydogs.org/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=fcdbc36d17&e=c0babbc643 "https://firstrespondertherapydogs.org/"). **Newly elected officials get dose of Leadership Council training** I was proud to kick off a two-day training for newly elected and emerging leaders of by the Leadership Council San Mateo County at the CZI Community Space in downtown Redwood City Thursday, Feb. 25. The learning objectives were to forge effective working relationships with elected colleagues; learn about economic development and demographic shifts in San Mateo County; foster and inclusive community; and contribute to a shared vision for the future of the county. This year — 2025 — is a special milestone for San Mateo County. We are not just celebrating another year; we are celebrating a legacy of service. This year marks the 169th year of our county — a time to reflect on how far we’ve come, the leaders and the families from our past who paved the way, and to dream about where we are headed. At the conference, attendees developed new relationships in our shared vision to ensure every resident in San Mateo County is housed, has access to health care, nutritious food and is safe from harm. With median home prices of $2.4 million, our cities face a housing affordability crisis that is eroding our middle class and increasing the numbers of those who face homelessness. We all know this and the only way to address it is if we work together across our city borders and it’s the leaders of tomorrow who will be charged with doing that work into the future. Thank you to Leadership Council SMC Co-Presidents Kaarin Hardy and Margi Power for inviting me and San Mateo County Executive Mike Callagy to make welcoming remarks and speak about our own experiences as public servants. **I’m proud to add Caltrain to my public transit resumé** I was officially sworn-in to the Peninsula Corridor Joint Powers Board of directors Thursday, Feb. 7. The JPB is the governing body of Caltrain, which operates regional rail service in San Francisco, San Mateo and Santa Clara counties. The nine-member board of directors is composed of three members from each of the three partner agencies who are tasked with bringing the agency into solvency following the pandemic. I am excited to join the Caltrain Board of Directors and contribute to the amazing work that has been accomplished as ridership has jumped 41% since the line has become fully electrified. Serving on the Metropolitan Transportation District, SamTrans, the Peninsula Traffic Congestion Relief Alliance and now Caltrain, I am deeply committed to enhancing our region’s connectivity. My passion for regional transit drives my mission to ensure sustainable, efficient and accessible transportation for all. _Serving the region since 1863, Caltrain is the oldest continually operating rail system west of the Mississippi and the first railroad to convert from diesel to electric power in a generation.__ _ **Interns wanted to join our team ** We are looking to add to our great group of interns we are currently working with. If you or someone you know may be interested in applying to my Internship Program, submitting this form is the first step: [https://forms.gle/hiKqtn7Rird5vXwB9](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=5c16510fe9&e=c0babbc643 "https://forms.gle/hiKqtn7Rird5vXwB9?fbclid=IwAR3YFH0mH828rtAUru5EFOO9GsMCasQYe1N7AUrmwAwBf30JTtXOSeCzKjs"). You can also reach out to Mike Richardson on my staff directly with any questions at [mrichardson@smcgov.org](mailto:mrichardson@smcgov.org "mailto:mrichardson@smcgov.org"). In friendship,
**DAVID J. CANEPA**
President, San Mateo County Board of Supervisors

# Friday, March 7, 2025
---|---
**Good Afternoon!** If a cat can conquer the slopes while parachute-skiing, you can handle whatever comes your way. In today’s _Feel Good Flyover_ , we’ve got a daredevil kitty who looks [darn cute in his tiny helmet](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kL2OqzAQhZ8GuonM2GAoXNwmXW67JTJ4jCdrMDJOIt5-xT7AludHR0ff12N8WI68Lf_tSsYvfiw-jSiwBSFB6NFZjueoamc8EZKsyTRaNVIPXaPrYCROahoaiTS11JNtXY-dFyR1bycnsGZzrQkpNArUSt36QWM7CD1Pyvq2bSslyHFJ-fZMvJVAPp7pTfk2p7WOJpSyH5X8V-G9wvtOaY90RRXeZ1tgt9nO4VUIjm8-4MMlQOADnM28LZA-G2WYsn1fqgSCOXCMJzxf634Ab5fH-epB4e2EQHGlAk3T9cOgdZ2N2z8cIx-drpRYVsvx91n5i9bb4E8AAAD__6Ppb78) and a hero bus driver who saved 15 middle schoolers from a burning bus—because bravery comes in all shapes, sizes and species. | Peter -- We have some very exciting news out of Utah today! Senator Daniel Thatcher has changed his affiliation to the Forward Party. He is now the first sitting state Senator to bear that affiliation. See what the Utah team had to say about the announcement [here](https://www.forwardparty.com/media/press_release/utah_sen_thatcher_leaves_gop_joins_forward/?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_sen_thatcher_announcement&n=2 "Utah Sen.
Thatcher leaves the GOP to join the Forward Party") and below, and read about the Senator and this switch in the [Salt Lake Tribune here.](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=bFgHPJC2qbzXh_VTsyZga1HzQqIXpjaeOiFYIP8VEEkiulicnvxpj6tOm-AK1OdzUX0GVT-Ned1ioDl0n886M3C2iglWK4plprnJYvJGP8EVZYc1x7LPVUj9Dd-aIjtt&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_sen_thatcher_announcement&n=3 "Sen. Dan Thatcher is leaving Utah’s
Republican Party to ‘break the deadlock’ in politics") The Forward Party today is proud to accept Senator Daniel Thatcher (SD 11: Salt Lake, Tooele, Utah Counties) as its first elected member of the Utah State Senate. On the last day of the legislative session, the Senator left the GOP to join the Forward Party, citing the Party’s principles of transparent, effective governance, and their value of treating everyone with dignity and respect. Andrew Yang, former Presidential candidate and Forward’s Founding Co-Chair, said, “Today more than ever, our elected officials are followers. It takes courage to step forward and truly lead. Senator Thatcher continues to demonstrate his morals through the leadership he’s showing today, and we couldn’t be more proud that he’s joining Forward.” In front of a crowd of press and supporters, Sen. Thatcher delivered a speech expressing his disappointment with Utah’s GOP leadership, particularly in regards to their continued efforts to stymy Utahns’ right to democratic participation, citing examples such as the recent passage of HB 300 making the vote-by-mail process more onerous, and last year’s battle over Amendment D and the legislature’s efforts to control the results of citizen-led ballot initiatives. He encouraged other citizens who are more aligned with the Forward Party’s principles to join him in switching their registration by visiting [https://vote.utah.gov/](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=4v5Bngae0iWHhUNK4xkTU5i6DU5brLq2QFl4_fpYaZw&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_sen_thatcher_announcement&n=4). In particular, the Forward Party’s values of respect for the rule of law and the Constitution; restoring power to the voters; driving on effective solutions; and individual liberty, personal responsibility, and civic engagement resonated with the Senator as he made his decision to switch his affiliation. The Forward Party is incredibly proud to accept Sen. Thatcher into our ranks. He has served his district honorably since 2011 as a champion to the downtrodden and forgotten. Among his many accomplishments during this time include spearheading the national 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline. In a fraught time when so many Americans feel the legacy parties no longer represent them, the Forward Party welcomes all to join our movement. The Forward Party is a 50-state movement that seeks pragmatic, data driven, and collaborative solutions without regard to ideology, while affirming a commitment to democracy, the Constitution, and rule of law. Lt. Gov Kerry Healey, Forward’s Executive Chair who served as Mitt Romney’s Lieutenant Governor in Massachusetts, said, “I was in Utah several years ago as our state leadership team delivered their petitions to the state house to become a recognized party, and I’m here in spirit today as Senator Thatcher joins the Party. We are excited for such a principled leader to join our ranks. Senator Thatcher’s focus on serving his constituents in a transparent and accountable manner embodies Forward’s approach to governance. We expect our elected officials to stand up for what is right, what they believe, and what their constituents want, and we will support Senator Thatcher as he continues to do so. And we welcome any other leaders to join Senator Thatcher who want to be a part of a Party that won’t require them to compromise their morals to toe the party line. Forward Party

| | | | | [](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xuee40Iteknop5I9ITm7zj28i1&s=FCAHBKNJJDPHMIGP)

Friend, As the producer of the feature film _Sound of Freedom_ , I helped sound the alarm about the horrific realities of the $9.5 BILLION human trafficking and child sex industry._Sound of Freedom_ was a box office hit and gave us the platform to spread awareness about children who must be rescued from unimaginably horrific realities. And now, through The Sound of Freedom Foundation, we identify and track cases of child abduction and trafficking, and we tirelessly search for and rescue defenseless victims. **[**Will you partner with the Sound of Freedom Foundation today in this critical work by making your most generous tax-deductible gift of $25, $50, $100, or more right away?**](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xuee40Iteknop5IaITm7zj28i1&s=FCAHBKNJJDPHMIGP)**
---
[ Support the Sound of Freedom Foundation](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xuee40Iteknop5IbITm7zj28i1&s=FCAHBKNJJDPHMIGP)
---
A **massive surge in immigration** , **skyrocketing drug use** , and**homelessness** are some of the factors that increase the likelihood of being trafficked......but, the reality is that perpetrators of child sex trafficking are skilled in identifying victims and exploiting their vulnerabilities.The result is heart-wrenching for victims and their families.An empty seat at the dinner table.A backpack collects dust as it hangs in the hallway.The pain and anguish that comes from being the family whose child has been abducted by criminals and sold into sex trafficking.And, worst of all, the innocent child who's scared, hurt, and abused by human traffickers.Right now, children are waiting to be rescued from horrific conditions, and it's up to you and me - working together through the Sound of Freedom Foundation - to help God's children return to their parents. **[Your immediate support of $25, $35, $50, $100, or more would be a blessing toward saving the lives of innocent children. I pray you'll help us to rescue victims of sex trafficking with your tax-deductible gift to the Sound of Freedom Foundation today.](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xuee40Iteknop5IcITm7zj28i1&s=FCAHBKNJJDPHMIGP)**
---
[ Support the Sound of Freedom Foundation](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xuee40Iteknop5IdITm7zj28i1&s=FCAHBKNJJDPHMIGP)
---
In many cases, including those of the children whose story was told in _Sound of Freedom_ , abduction occurs internationally and there are costs associated with hiring attorneys, filing petitions, and even traveling to the country where the child is located.While the cost of returning an abducted child varies depending on the case, the truth is that the rescue of a missing child is an incredibly complex and expensive task._No family deserves to continue staring at an empty seat at the dinner table because there isn 't the financial ability to continue their fight._God's children are NOT for sale, which is why we must act immediately to SAVE these innocent lives from sex trafficking. **[**I hope I can count on your tax-deductible gift of $25, $50, or more to the Sound of Freedom Foundation today to help us reunite young girls and boys who have been trafficked.**](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xuee40Iteknop5IeITm7zj28i1&s=FCAHBKNJJDPHMIGP)**
---
[ Support the Sound of Freedom Foundation](https://e.nl.vintagetec.com/re?l=D0I2xuee40Iteknop5IfITm7zj28i1&s=FCAHBKNJJDPHMIGP)
---
Together, we can set them free!Many blessings,Eduardo Verastegui
_Sound of Freedom_ , Producer

Through nine virtual meetings covering every Congressional district and hundreds of written submissions, you showed up, spoke out and shaped this conversation.
Thank you to the 1,500+ participants who took the time to engage, share their perspectives, and build community. Your willingness to speak candidly about the challenges we face and the future we’re fighting for is what makes our party strong. Your feedback is shaping how we move forward.
At the same time, we acknowledge that this is just one step in an ongoing conversation. The voices included in this report represent a dedicated but small fraction of Massachusetts Democrats. We are committed to continuing our outreach to ensure that we uplift the perspectives of all communities, especially those who have historically been marginalized.
Now, it’s time to turn what we’ve heard into action. Read the full Listening Tour Report here [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Ud326zRgmkPmbARhV-Bowqq0xGtnQuU435aDg7Cd4yA/edit?usp=sharing] and join us in organizing, advocating, and pushing for real progress. | | _**Protecting Women and Putting Families First**_
---
Friends, This week has been a whirlwind for conservative Hoosiers, with Governor Braun continuing at a breakneck pace and President Trump delivering his fiery Address to a Joint Session of Congress. This week, leading up to International Women's Day tomorrow, Governor Braun has made empowering and protecting women his top priority. On Monday, he issued an executive order greatly expanding paid parental leave for state employees and offering paid childbirth recovery leave for new mothers. The Governor has encouraged business leaders to follow his example, and believes our state must work towards greater support for new families and working mothers. The very next day, Governor Braun issued executive orders to protect collegiate women's sports, by ensuring young women are not forced to compete against biological males, and protected female only spaces be mandating Indiana law recognize biological sex rather than radical gender ideologies. Here at the Indiana GOP HQ, we commend Governor Braun for his bold leadership, his administration's unprecedented pace of action, and his commitment to protect women and put families first. As always, thank you for being a part of our Indiana GOP team and please do not hesitate to reach out if I can ever be of assistance.
---
| |
---
| | Lana Keesling, Indiana GOP Chairwoman

| | _**Governor Braun Signs Executive Order to Strengthen Parental and Childbirth Leave for State Employees**_
---
---
**Governor Mike Braun** on Monday, signed an executive greatly strengthening parental leave for State employees, increasing paid time off for all parents following the birth or adoption of a child and guaranteeing paid childbirth recovery leave for new mothers and those who tragically suffer a late-term miscarriage. **What he said** : “Strong families are the cornerstone of strong communities, and it’s so important for a family to have quality time to care for their newest member. I believe employers should do everything they can to accommodate the needs of new parents, and today I’m setting an example by strengthening our state’s policies for paid parental leave (including adoption), childbirth recovery leave, and paid leave for those facing the tragedy of losing a baby. These new paid parental leave policies will benefit women recovering from childbirth, their spouses, and the newborns whose health and development will be improved by more time with their parents in those first critical weeks. Indiana supports strong families!” \- **Governor****Braun** , via a [press release](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/oRJMWBEbfOGRnWQQz6GpFaeml-HJ_F4zp9ijWhdokcYXZPNiQPyDnqj4wEKjKkeoMDB3VZGtLBMzxAiEckp99VmzMp-szrO6vh2U9WXUNploKjt6WH-ScFjRnjUGEt7P1YTxvAweoqA3PPkVhUKdmNbOKnJaR4y_7MaoLAj4dGXaAncYqkfr1ZnjkqXU_p6gDd3WUGr2kki4_Sl-FDufKjQpoAKrCAMVD-IW8e89ze6_na99Vv-DsZUq27biYar0239jrpVctHIzx-qF1YWbEADa2KRaQ9b0RC2GOsXzu93nDb5rl3P4AB-tGK4fKjE3g8kksH6d9Bd4KFEPDLI12uZpVIsQ2RfyHW26ObPVxM17HfVQy30LrjLWNY6QJ6CvJfXR9BqP5TDFwfB0DGIu_rWtKr6dNoq6IHQp7SP2OAg04b-bDhFylJ29NBjbewL6IegkSL9A4y-h9_Cu3ZS_5a_qd4bxN4GP91wSHxTiHpMzJKLD54_oM8VkRYz6bAFxE-P2mcgSeQ0P/USIKTcF6jfQGncdH1XADVCRsoxIbG6s3/6).
---
**_Governor Braun Signs Executive Orders Protecting Women's Sports and Biological Sex_**
---
---
**Governor Mike Braun** on Tuesday, signed two Executive Orders, the first ensuring that female athletes in college sports are not forced to compete against biological males, and the second ensuring that Indiana law is based on biological sex and not extremist gender ideologies. **What he said** : "Replacing the scientific fact of biological sex with the always-changing, self-reported idea of ‘gender identity’ has real consequences: it puts women in danger in female-only spaces like prisons, it destroys opportunities for women in sports, and it tells troubled kids that their mental health problems can be solved with sterilizing drugs and irreversible sex change operations. Indiana will not go along with this radical new idea of what gender means, and we will not allow tax dollars to be used to promote this ideology — instead, we’re going to focus on providing Freedom and Opportunity for all Hoosiers." \- **Governor****Braun,** via a [press release](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/J_wTWkqiwvR-zQpmI6J5srHJpaJFubL7qZ7ojE4yc5HBVWrXPHnzViwFivGMM0fsK-hVCpAPl-37dXsjnGuL8PchymJU5LZs4n236MsexBJbzh-4jUGPjiTDe7NtggUjTQvby5RdhizZiLZTtgzJ8Uq1P4FhNPM5IqDPsAh-4VouN_B-okrNvByGUPTnV88o0mpef2OE2y8G7mJsMTI7CpL8qPUQFCYwH9lTwJWMFduZ1wS5_I_EqWrh8oLBWr2CWSt6WJnbLx30pO7DKdFrJlX2dS7t6O69o6_JBVO-PE0t2ZzHhDdFY3osSUoNr6-Y0e-3oWL6ptGBmG5HseiVNxfs4bTDEEt2rVEPeIPXJ5tvVOmvda4VwVS3p13drlUAj44a8QPKS1ftP0kmufw4X-WETb1J4Es5Tf98gHFkE-gHh0Bo1zQ2Zqt4MjUdnKSehZQPDh4PoSqQp_rjPd90pmbm2do2TNvycTyXclm2UZ6AvQeu54DqMS59SzgTEPCgA00/OBdU8WJJSRCOpQczNguuCQjwU6zpINRG/6).

SPRINGFIELD – Illinois lawmakers are once again trying to chip away at parental rights, this time going after homeschool families with HB2827, a bill that would force new restrictions and government oversight on those who choose to educate their children at home. For decades, homeschooling families in Illinois have enjoyed the freedom to educate their kids as they see fit, free from bureaucratic interference. But now, lawmakers want to change that with a bill that would require annual reporting, portfolio reviews, and even qualifications for parents who homeschool.

Instead of fixing Illinois’ broken education system, lawmakers are focused on controlling families who choose to opt out.

Peter –

With so much happening in our government, Kim is making connecting with constituents a top priority. **That’s why she has already hosted four townhalls since the start of the 119th Congress.**

Just last night, Kim held a townhall for _7,400 Washingtonians_. And in February, one of Kim’s townhalls had _14,000 people show up_. This was one of the largest of the most recent townhalls for any congressional person—even Rachel Maddow herself was impressed when she shared the news on _MSNBC_!

WA-08 had a lot to say in these townhalls—**and Kim was there to listen.**

People are worried about rising grocery prices, the high cost of living, and partisan gridlock getting in the way of real solutions. Our district showed up and showed out, making it clear folks are ready for leaders who are focused on them, not political games.

Kim is working around the clock to bring your concerns straight to Congress. She’s working to lower costs for working families by holding corporate price gougers accountable, fighting for lower prescription drug prices, and fighting back against extremist politicians who are more interested in stoking division than solving problems.

But keeping our momentum with the GOP's trifecta— _and ensuring Kim has the resources needed to fight back_ —won’t be easy. Extreme Republicans and their special interest allies are ready to say, do, and spend whatever it takes to get their way while ignoring the best interests of the American people. Simply put: **we can’t afford to let that happen.**

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6df9oufg2i43xdivje4931y1po89kyqzjqtiokzi4qzz6bs43xf3qmt3k8pspho598pf4jsrwx2a4al5d5jlopjhwjdllkmaw0enwyxvw0jp5dx7xs5ukj4ld6gbv8h8wyoiv2aytvx93wzygbzjt&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssrufi&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssrufi&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssrufi&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssrufi&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6df9oufg2i43xdivje4931y1pxhoqg6xe6r3ezg9dx091vcg1o0cwt0wsqiw3njwn4mhsjlhrzcus12hxl3380w5nyaekh8lvjv6rt3w6ppqa2uieu2yxw4y0hdlsbae4kyxhh59tqykf2oc5zop5&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssrufi&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssrufi&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/103448436/532202252/1895761198?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NDBmMjFhYi05ZmZiLWVmMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2IqP2Sl_RZ3HESJjKSL8I7du5Ntu9jHVdbAkK9ekwEU=&emci=641c18a5-9ffb-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=940f21ab-9ffb-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=13185894) Hey Derek, it’s Chris Deluzio.

I’m a Rust Belt Democrat from swingy Western PA—and I’m here to tell you something that you may not hear from other folks: _**not all tariffs are bad.**_

Opposing all tariffs signals that you’re comfortable with exploited foreign workers making your stuff at the expense of American workers. I’m not and neither are most voters.

In fact, many of my constituents support smart tariffs, particularly ones that target China, and so do I.

**But tariffs are effective only when used in a predictable and stable way and the Trump administration’s approach has been anything but.**

His scattershot threats are unanchored to real industrial strategy, won't result in rebuilding manufacturing, and ultimately hurt American workers more than helping them.

**Volume 1: How We Got Here**
Peter:
A redistricting case is once again before the U.S. Supreme Court — because anti-democratic special interests are still determined to gerrymander at the expense of American citizens.
The case is called _Louisiana v. Callais_. It’s about a new electoral map that has finally led to fair congressional representation for Black Louisianans. And it touches on just about every aspect of our work.
Between now and oral argument on March 24, you’ll hear more from us about the backstory of this legal fight, what it means for voters, and how our fair maps movement continues to fight for equal representation in Louisiana and across the country.
To kick things off, this email is Volume 1 — a breakdown of the crucial facts at hand.
**How this case got started**
Black voters in Louisiana are about one-third of the state’s population. But before the current congressional map was in place, Black voters could only elect a candidate of their choice in one of the state’s six congressional districts.
That was a textbook violation of Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act (VRA), which protects our democratic process against racial discrimination. So in 2022, our affiliate, the National Redistricting Foundation, supported a tenacious group of Louisiana voters who challenged the unfair map in court. The case was ultimately successful and directly led to a more representative map that includes two districts where Black voters have a meaningful opportunity to elect candidates of their choice — what are called ‘Black opportunity districts.’
**The ongoing fight**
**However, shortly after the new, VRA-compliant map went into effect, one of the most ideologically-driven federal courts in the country struck it down** — ignoring recent precedent that affirmed the enforcement of Section 2, including the U.S. Supreme Court’s 2023 decision in _Allen v. Milligan._
Louisiana voters then took their case to the Supreme Court. They asked the justices to block the decision striking down the new, fair map and to instead keep the VRA-compliant map in place for the 2024 elections while the case was appealed. The Supreme Court did so.
**What happens next**
**On March 24, the Supreme Court will hear oral arguments in the case.** Their ruling will not only determine the future of Louisiana’s VRA-compliant congressional map, but also could impact the future of critical VRA protections.
The justices should have an easy decision to make. The Supreme Court has a duty to uphold its own precedent and protect voters’ rights to equal representation as enshrined in the Voting Rights Act. That would mean protecting the voting rights of Black Louisianans — by permanently reinstating Louisiana’s VRA-compliant congressional map.
**For far too long, Black Louisianians have been denied their rightful representation at the ballot box.** That’s why our affiliate has supported a courageous group of Louisianans in asking the Supreme Court to protect voters' rights to equal representation as enshrined in the VRA.
Leading up to oral argument, different members of the All On The Line team will send you additional emails about this case. They’ll lay out the background, the stakes, and what comes next in our ongoing fight for fair maps.

[That's why I'm writing to ask you to participate in Hillsdale College's **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY**](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/s/c/CtJrsABbzZ6lT4EW-Gcu4EBXBH7DTF2G1PIwJdhxmTWTTK20qtjYR8FE86IaaeFMICq3ecHP1HO0ruAfZi8c1pLMj9O7uML3S-s9WiD4tokazz1lMe0wSnyxPiEv-QvFFmydDO8QIh705OpuqTZpXwGoVA5NvBk0YP1AWDkH5v4QlfHiFnCxLZaNMaAC7WFOiTK15vhwgzfnIr8X8cnrOx9sjkSBdZy0pg0IHtqWz0_xCVzKW8oMLM3GrM2eQk3aHoR52UAOMXqN6fdLhXb4T0ajbFMHcDUImfUJbeIZA69yi1x6V_KuQ-Rwlaq_ctmWuiap2amCF_2VPrJjdeZWXo09dun9uIbGLLs1SWKSqUdZ3QSuTCQucVXY1uG5AOKjtobKCqA0v8T7gf7Za2idEeF5bkCPG583IM4Ft42DIn68Zs-8we29jw/5lkR7Hadc-s1YoonPn6v84jLTLJnQkKC/6).

Like many Americans, I'm sure you're all too aware of the damage that has been done to our country by policies implemented in the name of "Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion" or "DEI."

Race grifters and hustlers make _millions_ perpetuating DEI lies, including...

* America is a nation built on slavery, not freedom.
* All racial disparities are indisputable evidence of systemic racism--and if you question this conclusion, you must be a racist.
* Students in K-12 schools can be divided into oppressors and oppressed based on their skin color.

DEI policies have infected almost every aspect of American life, from K-12 schools to college admissions and job applications. They have even spread into the hard sciences and the military.

These policies endanger lives and, ultimately, Western Civilization itself.

I'm sure, like a lot of Americans, you want to know what you can do to stop DEI. One of the most fundamental steps is ...

**Countering the far-Left ideologies that are being taught to students in K-12 schools, colleges, and universities.**

Hillsdale College, where I am president, is engaged in a nationwide fight on the battlefield of education to save young Americans from this anti-American agenda.

Since our founding in 1844, we have offered "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty."

To do this work well, we need a clear understanding of **what informed Americans like you think about DEI and how best to fight it.**

So please share your views by completing the **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time.

Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept any government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations.

**We remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities have rejected their founding statements and embraced radical and dangerous ideologies.**

Donald Trump fired hundreds of scientists, meteorologists, and technicians from the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) last week, including those responsible for local forecasts at National Weather Service offices across the country.
These are the experts who track hurricanes, predict tornadoes, and issue life-saving alerts. Cutting NOAA’s staff could put lives at risk.
**Here’s what this means in the short term:**
**1\. Your Weather Forecasts May Be Less Reliable.** NOAA provides the data that powers everything from TV weather reports to the apps on your phone. With fewer scientists running weather models, forecasts could become less accurate. If you live in an area prone to floods, wildfires, or winter storms, that’s a problem.
**2\. Less Time to Prepare for Extreme Weather.** Tornado season is just beginning, but many of the experts responsible for tracking storms in real time are no longer on the job. NOAA’s hurricane center and tsunami warning offices also lost staff, putting coastal communities at greater risk. The fewer forecasters and technicians monitoring severe weather, the harder it will be to issue timely warnings.
**3\. Farmers Will Struggle to Plan Ahead.** Agriculture depends on NOAA’s seasonal forecasts to determine when to plant, harvest, and prepare for droughts. Weaker forecasting means more uncertainty, which could hurt food production and drive up prices at the grocery store.
**4\. Disaster Response Will Be Slower.** When an oil spill happens, NOAA is responsible for tracking the damage and guiding cleanup efforts. The same goes for mapping safe shipping routes after storms. When a container ship hit Baltimore’s Key Bridge last year, NOAA played a critical role in reopening the port. Without enough staff, future disasters will be harder to manage.
So why is this happening? Because Trump and Elon Musk are hellbent on privatizing weather forecasting and putting profits over public safety. This isn’t about helping people — it’s about money and power.

clean_body: Every second on the sidelines matters. | | = Donald Trump fired hundreds of scientists, meteorologists, and technicians from the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) last week, including those responsible for local forecasts at National Weather Service offices across the country. These are the experts who track hurricanes, predict tornadoes, and issue life-saving alerts. Cutting NOAA’s staff could put lives at risk. Here’s what this means in the short term: 1\. Your Weather Forecasts May Be Less Reliable. NOAA provides the data that powers everything from TV weather reports to the apps on your phone. With fewer scientists running weather models, forecasts could become less accurate. If you live in an area prone to floods, wildfires, or winter storms, that’s a problem. 2\. Less Time to Prepare for Extreme Weather. Tornado season is just beginning, but many of the experts responsible for tracking storms in real time are no longer on the job. NOAA’s hurricane center and tsunami warning offices also lost staff, putting coastal communities at greater risk. The fewer forecasters and technicians monitoring severe weather, the harder it will be to issue timely warnings. 3\. Farmers Will Struggle to Plan Ahead. Agriculture depends on NOAA’s seasonal forecasts to determine when to plant, harvest, and prepare for droughts. Weaker forecasting means more uncertainty, which could hurt food production and drive up prices at the grocery store. 4\. Disaster Response Will Be Slower. When an oil spill happens, NOAA is responsible for tracking the damage and guiding cleanup efforts. The same goes for mapping safe shipping routes after storms. When a container ship hit Baltimore’s Key Bridge last year, NOAA played a critical role in reopening the port. Without enough staff, future disasters will be harder to manage. So why is this happening? Because Trump and Elon Musk are hellbent on privatizing weather forecasting and putting profits over public safety. As an organization, we exist for a simple reason: every eligible voter should be able to register to vote easily, cast their ballot easily, and have that ballot counted.
Stacey Abrams founded Fair Fight after significant large-scale voter difficulties in the 2018 election. Since then, we’ve made major strides:
* Supporting critical voter protection work in battleground states so more people can exercise their power in our democracy
* Mobilizing thousands of volunteers to reach hundreds of thousands of voters in midterm and runoff elections where the freedom to vote was on the line
* Helping elect pro-voter candidates like Georgia’s two Democratic senators, Reverend Raphael Warnock and Jon Ossoff

In 2025 and beyond, we’ll keep pressing forward — to stop or limit voter suppression tactics, expose the harmful agenda of anti-democracy extremists, and elect more voting rights champions (with key elections happening this year in Georgia).
**We’re inspired by how Stacey Abrams rolls up her sleeves and fights back when our rights are under threat.**
**And we’re grateful that you do the same.**
[**Your dedicated support makes this vital work possible. Will you make a donation of $25 or any amount to help say that none of us are backing down? CNN Republican Scott Jennings **[pushed Democrat Rep. Marilyn Strickland to the limit](https://substack.com/redirect/f5075907-93d6-45a1-8e0f-acb0edef0858?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with a brutally honest comment during a panel debate, Thursday.
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/f5075907-93d6-45a1-8e0f-acb0edef0858?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/f5075907-93d6-45a1-8e0f-acb0edef0858?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"Look I am no accustomed to helping your party do anything, but let me give you some advice; this was the dumbest thing I've ever seen, and seeing the comments today, Lord have mercy." Jennings said, as respectfully as he could, referring to a recent **[bizarre video posted by congressional democrats](https://substack.com/redirect/31a70876-9989-40d8-b1ea-c784d926924b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** imitating the video game Super Smash Bros.
"Look, scrambling for new social media strategies isn't a replacement for fixing what's actually wrong," Jennings continued. **["Your party has a 21% approval rating..." ](https://substack.com/redirect/f5075907-93d6-45a1-8e0f-acb0edef0858?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
"Lets talk about fixing what's wrong," Strickland snapped back. "Donald Trump is doing nothing for the American people!!"
Jennings fired back, "And he has a 50% approval rating!"
Watch the live T.V. clash right here:
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/f5075907-93d6-45a1-8e0f-acb0edef0858?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

"Who do you blame for that war?" Collins pressed back. "Putin started this war, Russia started this war. Do you disagree with that?"

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: Elon Musk
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
I actually believe that people should age with dignity in this country.

I believe that people should have access to healthcare.
Before people say "We don't have the money" for it:
We “don't have the money” for a better social safety net because **we let *ssholes like Elon Musk gut Medicaid and Social Security in order for him to pay for _his own_ tax cuts** and _his own_ billion dollars in private federal contracts.
This guy takes billions and billions of _your_ tax dollars, of _your_ public funds — and it's not just Elon.
A lot of these “tech guys” that were standing behind Trump at the inauguration talk about themselves as “tech,” but **they're really just defense contractors**.
They're the new Boeing. They're the new Lockheed Martin.
They are robbing us of the tiny slivers of what we have left in our collective public social safety net in order to get billion dollar defense contracts.
Because here’s the thing: you could fire every single federal worker, and it would still be only 4% of the federal budget.
**Where's all the rest of it going?**
If you actually wanted to go after 'waste,' fraud, and abuse, you will go after defense contractors.
But the problem is those are the guys who are making the money off of cuts to Medicaid, Medicare, and Social Security.
The Trump trifecta has taken hold, along with their billionaire donors.
Our movement for working families and everyday people will have to fight harder than ever these next four years.
[Help us continue the fight with a grassroots contribution today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250307.zW7DOw&refcode=em20250307-8299-P_FND_EGR_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8299%2E2526796%2EW0igMa)

In solidarity,
Alexandria

body:
Peter,

We wanted to make sure you saw this article in the Star Tribune highlighting Keith’s recent listening sessions:

Keith Ellison met with constituents in Trump-voting farm country. It was civil.

Karen Tolkkinen, Minnesota Star Tribune

“Keith Ellison did Tuesday what fewer and fewer politicians seem to want to do nowadays.

“The Minnesota attorney general met with his constituents.

“And not just any constituents. These constituents included calloused, weather-beaten farmers in deep-red western Minnesota, more accustomed to harvesting corn than mingling with Twin Cities liberals.

“Ellison did not shy away from the obvious political differences between him and many of those who gathered in a chilly farm shed in Stevens County on Tuesday. His mission was to talk about how industry consolidation is hurting farmers.”

READ MORE: https://www.startribune.com/keith-ellison-meet-with-constituents-in-trump-voting-farm-country-it-was-civil/601231880

Billionaires and big corporations want to keep us divided. But no matter where you live, who you vote for, or whether or not you agree on everything, everyone deserves to afford their lives and live with safety, dignity, and respect.

Thank you for supporting us,

Team Keith

Vice President JD Vance, Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth and Director of Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard visited the border near the Del Rio crossing. The good news is apprehensions from December 18th, 2024, near the end of Biden's term were 3670 and today just 43. The bad news is there is still a lot of work to do to fully secure our border including getting legislation passed so President Trump's action cannot be undone. Democrats made a fool of themselves in front of the president during his speech and have taken a shellacking online. Memes, clips and videos are going viral, Pelosi's scowl, Jasmine Crockett's hideous recreation of Kendrick Lamar's song and the most embarrassing of all the "Pick Your Fighter" video that Democrats created and actually posted. President Trump could literally cure cancer and not a single Democrat would clap. Their petty, childlike buffoonery knows no bounds. Bill O'Reilly joins me on today's show to discuss how President Trump is faring as well as his likes and dislikes about the administration. President Trump said that O'Reilly said he was "the greatest president ever, better than Washington." Did Bill actually say this, we've got it all for you right here on the Sean Spicer show!

Friend, No one chooses to get sick, and seeking essential medical care should never keep families in poverty. Yet millions of people—disproportionately Black and/or disabled people—are burdened with medical debt, brought about by our broken for-profit healthcare system. Nearly 1 in 5 U.S. adults have medical debt on their credit reports, which means they may be denied housing, employment, transportation, or other necessities simply because they got sick and could not afford healthcare costs. **To fix this injustice, I’ve introduced and passed legislation to ban medical debt from appearing on credit reports. I worked with the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) to get this done, and this federal agency is set to change the lives of 15 million Americans**** _this month_****by removing $50 billion worth of medical debt from their credit reports.** Now we must defend this victory as the Trump administration attempts to dismantle the CFPB, which is the agency dedicated to protecting people from corporations that try to rip us off. **Fortunately, just this week a federal judge extended her court order to protect CFPB staff from mass firings.** We must keep fighting back against attempts to destroy life-saving federal services—in the courts, in the streets, and in the halls of power. I’m pushing back against right-wing cuts to essential programs, including the state-federal health insurance program known as Medicaid, which covers 40% of U.S. children and 60% of nursing home residents. I will also keep pushing back against CEOs of health insurance and Big Pharma corporations that want to keep profiting off our pain, our illnesses, and our deaths. I’ve also co-led legislation to cancel medical debt in addition to removing it from credit reports. I will keep demanding our government end medical debt; expand Medicare coverage; lower prescription drug prices; provide Medicare for All; and support gender-affirming healthcare, reproductive justice, and much-needed health equity. It’s not an issue of resources—we can pay for these changes by taking from the Pentagon budget, which has failed 7 audits in a row but still gets nearly $1 trillion each year. We have the money for all these programs and more. We just need to keep building the political power to demand our government prioritize people over corporate profits. [**Can you chip in $5 or more to my campaign so we can keep building the political power we need inside and outside Congress? Together, we will defend and expand the programs that millions of Americans rely on, and at the same time we will keep demanding more transformative changes to ensure a government that helps everyone not only survive, but thrive.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsbJvjj203tPYjMhOk2UTl_OrC0RCN787aB0qTIEGsn53v_VkPc_cmJR76--2kLFvt_IDW36yS73YZIFTT4tW486plt51YIUZ3gWXQtdByALoZIOnoBuMdxdHXQi7apSXtEaZDtHgQH7A2vReEfQCIgs8J_DmrqTiYZM1cq8CR6hSLHC4ktjtABjUhGsfMPF4etVfin6ffmL6KpYdiCxYHRGDlwLAWneJxhPT7W2aIEI8AtJVNS-Ye7fQ0-TnFlhD5IGHM6DPpSsk0m6io70Q3-yINRrMfysonjEvIv1Rn37u-xGFikLQonr973w6y8iAOhKShiZw0D5dRsRDugqTOqRtm6t4tdS8BNnErNypScxg/4el/2DzcBmW0SgWnFZNKksNRBQ/h1/h001.4rAXB4K8SGvttBKnx1XDkPOm-NjJCVGKMdoAVO1PxDY) _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [Chip in $15 now](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsbJvjj203tPYjMhOk2UTl_OrC0RCN787aB0qTIEGsn58bUjZf_rXLPlGfS6ol-LJizBdcledr3d9F4LcEfaLyv7ODwWA7ftyfeLxBCzCKeX6O9UbHv2qLw7i6uQ4mMaJFFQnxfYgpDfpc8Hc9ibd8c-B5lAKYhkBx8n4jABg5Ro3S4xb74vBblEABwGGptkWRq2bvqs04PVAHnlzathMV3OcxoQXsktnJAiyNyUSaMvcGE1d_rYAtqbgl5NHGc9NbsUoya5EeH4kEnEt02dUBjlHcPNfXG3lDaNWZa3MT34SXY9Q7BCqXli7YvkLu4h62IQQl0Wx3aADq8ZVUTmfBI_O7Kf_gqo83_IMPcwRPWb8rLosi5nPFgBvyLbKsXP5ZR0uU8VCB4yQYTgT5B4klvMPUr_CIjqNMQH2DLf5CKdg/4el/2DzcBmW0SgWnFZNKksNRBQ/h2/h001.DWQnGbUBI--08Oc83KMwHVbzUUAUEG9L9tJhAgRo8Ac)

From: **Rashida Tlaib******
Date: Thu, Mar 6, 2025
Subject: Fighting Against Corporate Greed & Corruption
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com
Friend,
This week, a federal judge extended her court order to block Trump’s attempt to fire nearly all staff at the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau—the federal agency that protects working people from corporations that seek to rip us off.
**This is an important temporary win at a crucial time:** **I worked closely with the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau to remove $50 billion in medical debt from 15 million Americans’ credit reports, which should go into effect**** _this month_****.**
Last year I hosted the Director of the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) for a round table in Michigan about the crushing impact of medical debt on families. We heard directly from residents in my Congressional district, including one woman who had to navigate “astounding” medical bills after her husband was diagnosed with the terminal illness known as ALS.
Medical debt is the leading cause of bankruptcy in our country, and many families lose their homes or struggle to access necessities like housing or transportation because of debt collections listed on their credit report. Imagine being denied housing while wrestling with a major medical issue and mounting bills. This is unconscionable.
That’s why, since my first few months in Congress,**I’ve fought to ban medical debt from appearing on credit reports.** I passed this legislation in the House of Representatives but it wasn’t signed into law, so I worked with the CFPB to get it done. **I’ve also co-led legislation to end medical debt altogether** with Congresspeople like Senator Bernie Sanders, and as a member of the Medicare for All Caucus **I’ve co-sponsored legislation to secure universal high-quality healthcare for all**.
I will never stop fighting for the majority of Americans who live paycheck to paycheck and can’t afford expenses like medical emergencies. I will keep demanding changes to our profit-driven healthcare system, which is killing thousands of Americans each year because they can’t afford healthcare. Even among adults who have health insurance coverage, 1 in 5 have skipped medical treatment because of concerns about cost.
While continuing to push back against corporate greed, I will also continue defending the much-needed relief we won for 15 million Americans who can access more economic opportunities without medical bills on their credit reports. I will also keep pushing to expand life-saving programs like Medicaid and Medicare, to lower and cap healthcare costs, to secure Medicare for All, to end medical debt, and more.

clean_body: While defending programs like Medicaid, let’s also keep pushing for transformative changes like Medicare for All. | | | Friend, No one chooses to get sick, and seeking essential medical care should never keep families in poverty. Yet millions of people—disproportionately Black and/or disabled people—are burdened with medical debt, brought about by our broken for-profit healthcare system. Nearly 1 in 5 U.S. adults have medical debt on their credit reports, which means they may be denied housing, employment, transportation, or other necessities simply because they got sick and could not afford healthcare costs. To fix this injustice, I’ve introduced and passed legislation to ban medical debt from appearing on credit reports. I worked with the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) to get this done, and this federal agency is set to change the lives of 15 million Americans this monthby removing $50 billion worth of medical debt from their credit reports. Now we must defend this victory as the Trump administration attempts to dismantle the CFPB, which is the agency dedicated to protecting people from corporations that try to rip us off. Fortunately, just this week a federal judge extended her court order to protect CFPB staff from mass firings. We must keep fighting back against attempts to destroy life-saving federal services—in the courts, in the streets, and in the halls of power. I’m pushing back against right-wing cuts to essential programs, including the state-federal health insurance program known as Medicaid, which covers 40% of U.S. children and 60% of nursing home residents. I will also keep pushing back against CEOs of health insurance and Big Pharma corporations that want to keep profiting off our pain, our illnesses, and our deaths. I’ve also co-led legislation to cancel medical debt in addition to removing it from credit reports. I will keep demanding our government end medical debt; expand Medicare coverage; lower prescription drug prices; provide Medicare for All; and support gender-affirming healthcare, reproductive justice, and much-needed health equity. It’s not an issue of resources—we can pay for these changes by taking from the Pentagon budget, which has failed 7 audits in a row but still gets nearly $1 trillion each year. We have the money for all these programs and more. We just need to keep building the political power to demand our government prioritize people over corporate profits. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | Thank you so much. Your voice matters: Institutions like Congress and the White House have never made progress without massive pushes from the public. With you in this fight, Rashida P.S. I also wanted to share some more information about Medicaid, which has different names in different states. If you want to know the name of the Medicaid program in your state, check out this graphic from MoveOn: (Note: Some states have multiple names for Medicaid programs, so this is not an exhaustive list. MoveOn also noted a correction after making this graphic: in North Carolina, Medicaid is known as NC Medicaid.) \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Rashida Tlaib** Date: Thu, Mar 6, 2025 Subject: Fighting Against Corporate Greed & Corruption To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Friend, This week, a federal judge extended her court order to block Trump’s attempt to fire nearly all staff at the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau—the federal agency that protects working people from corporations that seek to rip us off. This is an important temporary win at a crucial time: I worked closely with the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau to remove $50 billion in medical debt from 15 million Americans’ credit reports, which should go into effect** this month. Last year I hosted the Director of the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) for a round table in Michigan about the crushing impact of medical debt on families. We heard directly from residents in my Congressional district, including one woman who had to navigate “astounding” medical bills after her husband was diagnosed with the terminal illness known as ALS. Medical debt is the leading cause of bankruptcy in our country, and many families lose their homes or struggle to access necessities like housing or transportation because of debt collections listed on their credit report. Imagine being denied housing while wrestling with a major medical issue and mounting bills. This is unconscionable. That’s why, since my first few months in Congress,I’ve fought to ban medical debt from appearing on credit reports. I passed this legislation in the House of Representatives but it wasn’t signed into law, so I worked with the CFPB to get it done. I’ve also co-led legislation to end medical debt altogether with Congresspeople like Senator Bernie Sanders, and as a member of the Medicare for All Caucus I’ve co-sponsored legislation to secure universal high-quality healthcare for all. I will never stop fighting for the majority of Americans who live paycheck to paycheck and can’t afford expenses like medical emergencies. I will keep demanding changes to our profit-driven healthcare system, which is killing thousands of Americans each year because they can’t afford healthcare. Even among adults who have health insurance coverage, 1 in 5 have skipped medical treatment because of concerns about cost. While continuing to push back against corporate greed, I will also continue defending the much-needed relief we won for 15 million Americans who can access more economic opportunities without medical bills on their credit reports. I will also keep pushing to expand life-saving programs like Medicaid and Medicare, to lower and cap healthcare costs, to secure Medicare for All, to end medical debt, and more. Last month I held a town hall in my district about erasing medical debt and the pathway to Medicare for All, where organizational leaders and public health experts shared their experiences fighting for universal healthcare. Without Medicare for All, millions of people lack coverage, while expenses continue to rise. We all deserve so much better than a broken healthcare system that profits off of sickness and leaves more than 20 million people without health insurance. We deserve a system that guarantees healthcare as a human right. I will keep pushing for a society where all of us can thrive, and I will keep pushing back against right-wing threats to steal from us in order to pay forhuge tax breaks for billionaires and powerful corporations. For example, I voted no and spoke out against the Republican budget framework passed last week by the U.S. House of Representatives. I’m continuing to stay loud about how it’s disgraceful that Republicans and unelected billionaires are trying to dismantle the taxpayer-funded social services that our communities rely on. Everyday people continue to speak up as well. GOP members of Congress keep hearing from their upset constituents across political parties after taking actions like voting to cut the state-federal health insurance program known as Medicaid. Polls show strong bipartisan support for lowering and capping healthcare costs, with 84% of Republicans in favor of canceling medical debt. Most support Medicaid as well. Medicaid covers 1 in 5 Americans—including 60% of all nursing home residents and nearly 40% of all children. However, many people may not realize that their healthcare is covered by Medicaid, because Medicaid is called a variety of names depending on what state you live in. In my state of Michigan, for example, our Medicaid program is called Medical Assistance. The organization MoveOn made this graphic that names Medicaid in each state: (Note: States like Indiana and Minnesota have multiple names for Medicaid programs, so this is not an exhaustive list. After posting, MoveOn made a correction that Medicaid is known as NC Medicaid in North Carolina.) While Congress was on recess last week, I held a town hall in my district about advocating to protect federal programs and our communities. We had a panel with nonprofit groups MoveOn, Indivisible, and Democracy Forward to provide action items for residents who want to help educate, organize, and resist the attacks on vital federal programs and services. People showed up across the country at town halls last week, which is an important way to push your Senators and your Representative in the U.S. House. When many Republican Congresspeople fail to listen to their constituents’ demands for them to hold town halls in their districts, Americans are showing up in protest anyway. At least one Republican Senator shamefully left in the middle of a town hall last week, which was packed with his constituents who were upset about cuts to federal programs like the Department of Veteran Affairs. We know that too many leaders in our government are ignoring or are completely out of touch with the people they’re supposed to represent. I’m pushing to change that because we deserve a real democracy that helps everyone thrive. Will you join me? subject: Tell your Senators to vote NO on Mike Huckabee
body:
Write to your Senators urging them to reject Mike Huckabee’s nomination to be the Ambassador to Israel.
#
Peter,
Donald Trump has nominated Mike Huckabee – an extreme anti-Palestinian bigot – to be the US Ambassador to Israel. **We cannot let him get confirmed without a fight.**
**[Can you take a moment to write to your Senators urging them to reject Mike Huckabee’s nomination?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140614?t=2&akid=36486%2E1203867%2EGEP45g)**
Huckabee is the last person who should be serving as Ambassador to Israel. He believes Israel owns all of the West Bank, denies the existence of Palestinians as a people, and staunchly supports Benjamin Netanyahu and his far-right government. He would empower Israel to continue their genocide against the Palestinian people and upend hope for peace and freedom for Palestinians in Gaza and the West Bank.
The United States cannot continue to support Netanyahu’s genocidal war against Palestine. We must rally as a movement to stop Trump and Huckabee by calling on all Senators – _**Democrats and Republicans alike**_ – to reject this extremist nomination.
**[So please, use this link to write a letter to your Senators asking them to vote NO on Mike Huckabee’s nomination to be Ambassador to Israel. We’ve included a letter template, or you can write your own.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140614?t=3&akid=36486%2E1203867%2EGEP45g)**
**[Send a Letter](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140614?t=4&akid=36486%2E1203867%2EGEP45g)**
You’ll be joining Justice Democrats, MPower Action, and progressive organizations across the country rallying for peace and justice.
In solidarity,
Justice Democrats
